Description

About the Team

AWS Global Energy is responsible for powering the world's most demanding cloud infrastructure. The team is organized across three verticals: Global Energy Strategy (GES), which leads the development of innovative commercial structures to meet capacity demand and AWS's carbon-free energy commitments; Power Generation Solutions (PGS), the single-threaded owner for AWS power generation and energy engineering — delivering capacity solutions aligned with AWS's availability, reliability, sustainability, and redundancy requirements and managing the production readiness lifecycle of AWS-owned or commissioned generation and storage assets; and Energy Portfolio Operations (EPO), which owns Amazon's global renewable PPA portfolio and AWS CFE supply agreements. Global Energy partners closely with regional data center planning and delivery, global sustainability, and broader Amazon business units on energy procurement and infrastructure needs.

About the Role

As a Principal Technical Program Manager on the PGS leadership team, you will report directly to the Head of Power Generation Solutions and serve as a strategic partner to PGS and Global Energy leadership. This is a dual-scope role: you will own technical program management for one of PGS's power programs, while also driving cross-cutting strategy, controllership, and operational mechanisms for PGS and the broader Global Energy organization.

You will work at the intersection of technical execution and business strategy, partnering with PGS engineering leads, Global Energy Principals, Energy Portfolio Operations, Finance, and senior AWS leadership to ensure our programs are on track, our organization is scaled appropriately, and our strategy is clear and actionable. You'll engage external partners, facilitate senior executive interactions, and serve as a trusted voice for PGS in cross-organizational forums.

This role is right for someone who thrives in ambiguity, thinks big, and can operate with equal fluency in a technical design review and a VP-level strategy session.

About You

You have a track record of delivering complex, ambiguous programs at scale — and doing it with the business acumen and executive presence to bring senior leaders along. You are data-driven but not data-bound; you know when to go deep and when to synthesize. You write clearly, speak directly, and earn trust quickly across organizational boundaries. You utilize AI regularly and have experience driving AI solutions at scale. 

You are energized by consequential work. AWS's power strategy is shaping how the world's infrastructure gets built — and this role sits at the center of it.

Basic Qualifications

- Experience in technical program management, strategy, or related fields in a large-scale infrastructure, energy, or technology organization

- Experience managing complex, multi-stakeholder programs with senior leadership visibility

- Strong analytical skills with demonstrated ability to translate data into strategic recommendations

- Excellent written and verbal communication skills; experience preparing materials for VP-level audiences

Key job responsibilities

Key Responsibilities

Own technical program management for part of the AWS power program, including pipeline management, milestone tracking, senior leader engagement, and vendor coordination.

Partner with the Head of PGS to develop and maintain a multi-year strategic roadmap for Global Energy, translating long-term priorities into annual execution plans with clear owners and accountability mechanisms.

Lead Global Energy controllership mechanisms, including headcount and resource planning, hiring performance tracking, and operating cadence — ensuring leadership has timely, accurate visibility into organizational health and delivery status.

Develop and manage reporting for senior leadership on program status, strategic initiatives, and organizational metrics; synthesize complex inputs into clear, decision-ready narratives.

Build and maintain trusted relationships with Finance, Talent Acquisition, Human Resources, and partner delivery organizations to ensure Global Energy's full scope of needs is represented in cross-organizational planning.

Drive continuous improvement in Global Energy's operating mechanisms — identifying gaps, proposing solutions, and leading implementation across teams.

Represent PGS and Global Energy in senior forums, including facilitating off-sites, leadership reviews, and partner engagements inside and outside AWS.

Champion a high-performance team culture: model strong judgment, clear communication, and a bias for action.

About the team

The Power Generation Solutions team creates and delivers product and engineering solutions in for power and energy to help advance AWS’ mission to deliver world-leading cloud services. Our solutions are guided by four main principles; unlocking capacity growth, maintaining high infrastructure uptime, minimizing infrastructure costs, and advancing our net-zero carbon Climate Pledge. To deliver these solutions, our team provides technical input to realize a shared vision and strategy with partner teams and provides engineering support across the project or product lifecycle to deliver the solution. We also provide grid analytics and manage and develop models for determining the total energy and water use within our fleet of data centers and work with partners on improving overall performance.

- 4+ years of working directly with engineering teams experience

- Experience owning/driving roadmap strategy and definition

- 7+ years of experience in technical program management, strategy, or related fields in a large-scale infrastructure, energy, or technology organization

Preferred Qualifications

- Familiarity with energy development, permitting, or procurement processes

- Experience in organizational planning and mechanism or framework creation

- Experience with increasing efficiency through AI and automation.

Job ID: 10595764 | Amazon.com Services LLC

Description

Every Amazon fulfillment center, delivery station, and grocery store depends on the network gear, scanners, and devices that keep it running. Getting that hardware ordered, right-sized, and on site at the right time is still too slow and too manual. You'll build the program that fixes this, starting from a blank page.

We're looking for a Principal Technical Program Manager to define and launch a new program that connects how infrastructure is planned, ordered, and fulfilled across Amazon's global operations network. Today, product teams and thousands of field associates each work with supply chain in their own way. They rely on manual handoffs and country-specific workarounds, and nobody has a single view of the process. Your job is to replace that with one governed, automated way for infrastructure demand to turn into orders, deliveries, and ready-to-install hardware.

There's no existing program to inherit. You'll set the mission, the operating model, and the integration architecture. Then you'll lead the teams that build it. You'll work with engineering teams who are already committed to this work, and with senior leaders across supply chain, procurement, field operations, and technology.

Key job responsibilities

In this role, you will:

- Define the program from the ground up: its charter, guiding principles, operating model, and how teams work together across organizations.

- Break down where time is lost between a customer's request and a placed order, set baselines, and target the biggest gaps first.

- Design how self-service ordering and automated bill-of-materials tools connect to supply chain systems, so orders flow without manual re-entry.

- Build a data model that handles country-specific regulations and vendor constraints as part of the design, not as exceptions.

- Set up forward-looking demand signals, so procurement moves from reacting to individual requests to planning ahead.

- Decide which systems hold the source of truth for each type of data, and which existing tools to invest in, consolidate, or retire.

- Write the strategy and present it to senior leaders, shaping who owns procurement and deployment for new site launches.

You'll love this role if you're energized by ambiguity, enjoy building something that doesn't exist yet, and want your work to show up in faster site launches, less wasted spend, and a better experience for teams across Amazon's operations network worldwide.

A day in the life

About the team

We make infrastructure simple for every team that builds and runs technology across Amazon's operations network, from fulfillment centers to quick commerce sites worldwide. We build self-service products that let customers plan, order, and deploy infrastructure on their own, make the cost of every decision visible, and support complex programs that self-service can't handle yet. Each one teaches us what to automate next. You'll join product managers, engineers, solution architects, and program managers, partnering closely with supply chain, procurement, and field operations. We work backwards from the customer, measure outcomes over activity, and give people real ownership.

title: Senior Director, Global Commissioning & Handover
description:
About Volta

Volta is the category-defining, fully vertically integrated AI infrastructure platform – from capital to clusters to software, under a founder-led enterprise. Our mission is The Utility of Compute™: AI infrastructure as dependable and available as electricity, for every organization that needs it. Launched with a $10B strategic partnership with one of the leading frontier AI labs, a Series A led by Andreessen Horowitz, and a $5B AI Infrastructure Fund, Volta is building the infrastructure layer of the AI era from the ground up. We are 100+ people across London, Palo Alto, and New York, with rapid growth expectations to hundreds.

About The Role

Commissioning is where an AI factory becomes real. As Senior Director, Global Commissioning & Handover, you will lead commissioning of DSX facilities and network across all of Volta's sites, taking each one to ready for service and handing it over to our operations teams.

You will build and lead a global team that owns Volta's commissioning standards for electrical, mechanical and CDU scopes, systems security, commissioning planning, facilities readiness and operational readiness. Your team sets how commissioning is done on every site, from tagging through to the turn-up sequence, and holds the schedule that takes each facility live.

Time to market matters here. You will align commissioning to the turn-up sequence so that commissioning accelerates service rather than delays it, and you will make sure that when a building is handed over, the operations team, the procedures and the systems are ready to run it.

What You Will Be Doing

  • Lead commissioning of DSX facilities and network infrastructure across Volta's AI factories, taking each site to ready for service.

  • Build and lead the global Commissioning and Handover team, covering electrical, mechanical and CDU commissioning standards, systems security, commissioning planning, facilities readiness and operational readiness.

  • Own Volta's commissioning standards for each discipline, from tagging and method statements through each commissioning level to the turn-up sequence.

  • Own CDU installation and commissioning standards, including handover to operations.

  • Own the commissioning schedule for every site and its alignment to turn-up, so that commissioning is never the critical path to service.

  • Deliver the physical and systems security requirements for each site from construction through to handover.

  • Set the facilities readiness and operational readiness standards and governance, so each facility is ready for operations and the operations team is ready to run it.

  • Lead handover into service, working with DC Operations on acceptance, documentation and training.

  • Work with Design and Engineering, the regional delivery teams and the DSX execution and network teams so commissioning is integrated into the master schedule on every site.

  • Report commissioning progress and risk across sites, and feed lessons learned back into the standards and the reference design.

What You Bring

  • Experience leading commissioning of hyperscale data centres, including electrical, mechanical and liquid cooling systems. Data centre experience is essential.

  • A track record owning commissioning and handover across multiple concurrent sites at this level, and the ability to run it from day one.

  • Deep knowledge of commissioning levels, integrated systems testing and the turn-up sequence for high density GPU environments.

  • Experience with CDU and liquid cooling commissioning and handover into operations.

  • Experience setting readiness governance and handing live facilities over to operations teams.

  • Experience building and leading commissioning teams and managing commissioning agents and contractors.

  • Understanding of physical and systems security requirements in mission critical facilities.

  • Willingness to travel to sites across Europe and North America.

REQ-263

 

What We Offer

At Volta, we believe people do their best work when they feel supported, trusted and able to grow. We're building a company where you can make an impact, keep a healthy balance between work and life, and build a career you're proud of.
As a global team, we do our best to provide great benefits wherever you're based. While some benefits vary by country due to local regulations, we believe looking after our people is simply the right thing to do.

  • Competitive salary based on the work you do here, not your previous salary

  • Equity in Volta, giving you the opportunity to share in the company's long-term success

  • Retirement/pension contributions

  • Comprehensive health, wellbeing and insurance benefits

  • Generous number of vacation days each year

Additional Information

Background Checks

All offers of employment at Volta are conditional on the satisfactory completion of pre-employment screening, which includes confirmation of your right to work, verification of your employment history and a criminal record check, where this is permitted by local law. Screening is carried out by Zinc, an accredited third-party provider, after an offer is made and all information is handled confidentially and in accordance with applicable data protection law.

Equal Opportunity

Volta is an equal opportunity employer. We are committed to building a diverse and inclusive team and make employment decisions based on skills, qualifications, experience and business needs. We do not discriminate on the basis of race, colour, religion, sex, sexual orientation, gender identity or expression, national origin, age, disability, veteran status or any other legally protected characteristic.

Accessibility

Volta is committed to providing an accessible recruitment experience for all candidates. If you require accommodations or adjustments at any stage of the application or interview process, please contact us at

Candidate Privacy Notice

By applying, you consent to the processing of your personal data for recruitment purposes in accordance with applicable data protection laws, including the UK GDPR, EU GDPR and relevant US state privacy regulations. Your data will be shared only with those involved in the hiring process and will not be used for unrelated purposes. For details, see our Recruitment & Candidate Privacy Notice.

Note to Recruitment Agencies

Volta does not accept unsolicited CVs or candidate profiles from recruitment agencies. Any unsolicited submissions, including those sent directly to hiring managers or employees, will be treated as the property of Volta. No agency fees will be payable unless a valid, signed recruitment agreement is in place, and the agency has been specifically engaged for the relevant vacancy.

title: ETF Portfolio Analytics Director, Vice President, State Street Investment Management
description:
Who we are looking for

 

The ETF Portfolio Analytics Director, Vice President, is part of the Global ETF Research team. The role is responsible for developing and delivering customized portfolio analytics that help clients understand how portfolios are constructed, where vulnerabilities may be present, and how different investment solutions can support specific portfolio objectives.

 

The position combines portfolio diagnostics, asset allocation research, analytical tool development, and client-specific investment analysis. It covers both proprietary and non-proprietary funds and evaluates products according to the role they may play within a broader portfolio.

The role has a specific focus on:

·         Customized portfolio analytics and portfolio construction insights,

·         Strategic and tactical asset allocation analysis across asset classes, regions, factors, and investment styles,

·         Assessment of portfolio vulnerabilities, including concentration, unintended exposures, diversification gaps, drawdown sensitivity, liquidity considerations, and other sources of risk,

·         Evaluation of how proprietary and non-proprietary funds may serve different portfolio roles, such as core exposure, diversification, risk mitigation, income, liquidity management, or targeted return enhancement,

·         Development and maintenance of scalable analytical tools, methodologies, and client-ready portfolio diagnostics,

·         Leadership, quality oversight, and development of junior team members.

 

As an ETF Portfolio Analytics Director, you will work closely with ETF specialists, investment strategists, sales teams, and other stakeholders across the State Street Investment Management organization. You will translate complex portfolio findings into clear, commercially relevant insights and collaborate with marketing, product, and investment teams to support client engagement and business priorities.

The successful candidate will combine strong investment judgment with quantitative and communication skills. They will be able to move from portfolio-level diagnosis to practical asset allocation considerations, explain the interaction between holdings and exposures, and identify how individual funds can contribute to a coherent portfolio solution.

 

Why this role is important to us

 

The team you will join is part of State Street Investment Management, one of the world's largest asset managers, serving governments, institutions, and financial advisors globally. With more than four decades of experience and trillions of dollars in assets under management, we offer a broad range of investment solutions across asset classes, risk profiles, regions, and investment styles. As pioneers in index investing and ETFs, we continue to develop new ways to help investors build portfolios.

Clients increasingly need analysis that goes beyond selecting an individual fund. They need to understand how exposures interact at the portfolio level, whether diversification is effective, where risk may be concentrated, and which implementation choices are most appropriate for their objectives and constraints. High-quality portfolio analytics can turn fund-level data into actionable portfolio construction insights and is an important capability supporting the growth of our ETF business.

Join us if you are ready to make an immediate impact by helping clients identify portfolio vulnerabilities, evaluate asset allocation choices, and use investment products more effectively within complete portfolios.

What you will be responsible for

 

Customized portfolio analytics and portfolio diagnostics:

·         Lead the design and delivery of customized analyses for client portfolios, model portfolios, and strategic sales opportunities,

·         Assess portfolio structure across asset classes, regions, sectors, factors, currencies, investment styles, and underlying holdings,

·         Identify potential vulnerabilities, including concentration risk, overlapping exposures, unintended factor tilts, diversification gaps, drawdown sensitivity, liquidity constraints, and dependence on individual market outcomes,

·         Apply scenario analysis, stress testing, risk decomposition, performance attribution, correlation analysis, and other relevant methods to explain portfolio behavior,

·         Translate analytical findings into clear observations, trade-offs, and implementation considerations for clients and internal stakeholders,

·         Produce the Portfolio Insights and Analysis output, providing an in-depth assessment of portfolio construction, areas of weakness, potential risk, and opportunities to improve portfolio resilience.

 

Asset allocation and portfolio construction strategies:

·         Evaluate strategic and tactical asset allocation approaches in the context of client objectives, investment horizons, risk tolerances, liquidity needs, and implementation constraints,

·         Analyze how changes in asset allocation may affect portfolio risk, return drivers, diversification, and sensitivity to market scenarios,

·         Develop analytical frameworks that connect macroeconomic and market views with portfolio exposures and possible implementation choices,

·         Assess the role of different building blocks within a total portfolio, including core beta, active, factor, fixed income, liquidity, income, alternatives, and risk-management exposures,

·         Support the development of portfolio construction methodologies, model-based analyses, and repeatable frameworks for common client use cases.

 

Fund roles and implementation analysis:

·         Evaluate both State Street and third-party funds according to their potential function within a portfolio,

·         Analyze how different funds may provide core exposure, diversification, downside mitigation, income, liquidity, inflation sensitivity, duration management, factor exposure, or targeted growth opportunities,

·         Assess implementation trade-offs using holdings, returns, risk, liquidity, portfolio fit, and other relevant characteristics,

·         Use competitive and market analysis selectively to frame available implementation choices and explain material differences between approaches,

·         Provide data and analysis for client requests, including holdings, return streams, portfolio characteristics, risk measures, exposure analysis, and other relevant outputs.

 

Analytical tool and methodology development:

·         Maintain and enhance existing portfolio analytics tools using in-house capabilities and third-party data or technology platforms,

·         Develop scalable tools that support both repeatable high-volume analysis and detailed bespoke work for significant commercial opportunities,

·         Create robust methodologies for portfolio diagnostics, vulnerability assessment, asset allocation analysis, fund-role classification, and implementation comparison,

·         Improve workflow efficiency, data quality, methodological consistency, and the clarity of client-ready outputs,

·         Evaluate relevant external analytical capabilities where they can strengthen portfolio analysis or improve the client experience.

 

Commercial and stakeholder support:

·         Partner with sales, ETF specialists, and investment strategists to understand client needs and define the most relevant analytical approach,

·         Design targeted portfolio analyses that support specific client conversations and commercial opportunities,

·         Serve as a subject matter expert for portfolio analytics, portfolio construction, asset allocation, and ETF-related RFPs and DDQs,

·         Present complex findings in a concise and accessible way for technical and non-technical audiences,

·         Collaborate with product, marketing, investment, and technology teams to align analytical capabilities with client needs and business priorities.

 

Leadership and quality oversight:

·         Train and develop junior team members in portfolio analytics, investment interpretation, tool usage, and communication of findings,

·         Allocate and prioritize work across the team, balancing recurring deliverables with bespoke client opportunities,

·         Review analytical outputs for methodological soundness, accuracy, relevance, and claritt,

·         Ensure deliverables are completed accurately and on time,

·         Promote consistent analytical standards, documentation, and effective knowledge sharing.

 

What we value

These skills will help you succeed in this role:

·         Excellent quantitative, portfolio analysis, and investment interpretation skills,

·         Strong understanding of portfolio construction, asset allocation, diversification, risk decomposition, scenario analysis, and performance drivers,

·         Ability to identify portfolio vulnerabilities and distinguish material risks from less decision-relevant observations,

·         Ability to evaluate funds as portfolio building blocks and explain how different exposures may serve different investor objectives,

·         Experience designing analytical frameworks, automating processes, and developing scalable tools,

·         Strong attention to detail and a high degree of accuracy when working under pressure,

·         Ability to prioritize work, exercise sound judgment, and meet tight deadlines,

·         Ability to communicate technical analysis clearly in writing, presentations, and client discussions,

·         Good understanding of the global ETF and fund landscape, investment implementation choices, and relevant distribution channels,

·         Advanced knowledge of Microsoft Excel and PowerPoint; experience extracting meaningful insights from large and complex data sets is essential,

·         Ability to guide less experienced team members and develop their analytical skills,

·         Collaborative, self-motivated, intellectually curious, and comfortable working independently,

 

Education and preferred qualifications

·         Bachelor's degree or equivalent; an advanced degree or relevant professional qualification is beneficial,

·         10+ years of experience in a financial institution or finance-related industry, with substantial exposure to portfolio analytics, asset allocation, investment research, or portfolio construction,

·         Strong written and spoken English.

 

Other beneficial skills

·         Working knowledge of Bloomberg, Morningstar, FactSet, or comparable investment analytics and data platforms,

·         Experience with ETFs, mutual funds, model portfolios, multi-asset portfolios, or institutional portfolio analysis,

·         Programming or data-handling skills relevant to scalable analytics,

·         Experience developing analytical solutions using AI or advanced automation tools,

·         Knowledge of investment risk, market structure, liquidity, and portfolio implementation considerations,

·         Awareness of current market and economic issues and their potential portfolio implications.

Minimum Salary:​

The minimum salary quoted above applies to the role in the primary location specified. If the candidate ultimately works outside of this primary location, the applicable minimum salary may differ.​

Salary will be determined based on factors such as the position, type of work performed, individual skills, job description, working hours, diligence, initiative, self-management, length of employment, availability, and the quantity and quality of work delivered, as well as other objective and non-discriminatory criteria relevant to State Street employees.​

In addition to salary, employees are eligible to be considered for discretionary annual performance-based awards.​

​

We Offer:​

title: Currency Management Portfolio Manager, Assistant Vice President
description:
Who we are looking for

State Street Currency Management is seeking a Currency Portfolio Manager to join our team in Sydney, Australia.

The Currency Portfolio Manager is central to the daily management and implementation of institutional client currency hedging strategies. The Portfolio Manager analyzes and monitors client portfolio exposures relative to current hedge positions across funds and share classes and is responsible for the end-to-end management of assigned client mandates.

The role requires a strong understanding of FX markets, portfolio management, risk and controls, and client servicing. The successful candidate will work closely with colleagues across our global Currency Management team to deliver consistent client outcomes and effective global coverage.

Why this role is important to us

The team you will be joining is a part of State Street Markets (SSM). When owners and managers of institutional assets need research, trading, securities lending and innovative portfolio strategies, they turn to the SSM business unit. As our investment research and trading arm, SSM’s number one goal is to enhance and preserve our clients’ portfolio values by applying technology, optimizing trading, and linking asset classes and markets across the world. Join us if making your mark in the capital markets industry from day one is a challenge you are up for.

What you will be responsible for

As a Currency Portfolio Manager, you will:

Manage the daily implementation and oversight of currency hedging strategies for assigned institutional clients.

Monitor client portfolio exposures relative to current hedge positions and identify required rebalancing activity.

Ensure the completeness and accuracy of inbound client data, mandate compliance, portfolio calculations and client reporting.

Create and review FX orders, perform pre-trade due diligence and coordinate trade execution in accordance with client mandates.

Exercise sound judgment in managing client hedging programs, identifying potential data issues, mandate exceptions and operational risks, and escalating where appropriate.

Manage the full portfolio lifecycle, including rebalances and other client-directed or event-driven transactions.

Contribute to complex client events, including new client implementations, restructurings, and transitions

Perform post-trade review and ensure transactions and portfolio positions have been accurately reflected within Currency Management systems.

Monitor portfolio-level risks, including hedge ratios, currency exposures and client-specific mandate requirements.

Work closely with the global Currency Management team in Sydney, London and Boston to provide effective global coverage and seamless transition of responsibilities between regions.

Partner with trading colleagues on execution strategy, counterparty considerations and transaction-cost analysis where appropriate.

Participate in client due diligence meetings, service reviews, new-business presentations and ongoing client inquiries.

Contribute to enhancements to portfolio-management processes, controls, technology and monitoring capabilities.

Maintain a strong risk and control mindset, ensuring that portfolio-management activities are performed in accordance with established policies, procedures and client requirements.

Global Coverage: The role is based in Sydney, Australia and forms part of Currency Management's global portfolio-management coverage alongside colleagues in London and Boston.  The successful candidate must be comfortable managing responsibilities within a global operating model where client portfolios, instructions and issues may transition between regions. Clear communication, disciplined handovers, strong documentation and consistent adherence to portfolio-management controls are therefore critical to the role.

What we value

These skills will help you succeed in this role:

Demonstrated experience in currency portfolio management, FX markets, portfolio implementation or a related institutional investment-management function.

Strong understanding of FX products, particularly spot, forwards and swaps.

Experience managing institutional client portfolios or implementing hedging strategies.

Strong analytical skills with the ability to evaluate portfolio exposures, hedge positions and transaction requirements.

Excellent attention to detail and a demonstrated ability to operate accurately within time-critical deadlines.

Sound judgment and the ability to identify unusual data, portfolio or trading activity and escalate appropriately.

Strong understanding of investment-management risk and control principles.

Ability to communicate effectively with institutional clients and internal stakeholders.

Ability to work independently while contributing effectively within a global team.

Strong problem-solving skills and a proactive approach to process and control improvements.

Genuine interest in financial markets, currencies and institutional portfolio management.

Education & Preferred Qualifications

Bachelor's degree in Finance, Economics, Mathematics, Engineering or another quantitative discipline.

CFA designation or progress toward the CFA is preferred.

Relevant experience within institutional asset management, currency management, investment operations or global markets.

Experience with FX trading and portfolio-management platforms is beneficial.

Knowledge of transaction-cost analysis and execution-quality monitoring is advantageous.

title: Head of Cybersecurity
description:
About Us

KIDAN is a fast-growing, family-owned IT consulting company headquartered in Switzerland, serving nearly 1'000 enterprise clients. Since 2020, we’ve been helping businesses turn IT into a strategic advantage through smart, secure, and scalable solutions.

We specialize in IT management and security, and we are the exclusive Swiss distributor of ManageEngine, with strong partnerships including Cloudflare, Colortokens, SentinelOne, Zoho, Horizon3, Quest, and others. Our team of international experts is driven by excellence, integrity, and a people-first mindset.

At KIDAN, we don’t just solve IT problems—we enable long-term business success.

Be part of a mission where technology drives progress and people lead the way.

Job Description

Key Responsibilities

1. Own KIDAN's Cybersecurity Posture

  • Own KIDAN's overall cybersecurity posture, strategy, policies, standards and roadmap.

  • Ensure cybersecurity is embedded across KIDAN's technology, operations and internal environment.

  • Identify and challenge cyber risks, gaps and priorities, and drive corrective actions.

  • Own cybersecurity compliance and support certifications and frameworks such as ISO 27001.

  • Work closely with Technology, Operations and leadership to ensure cybersecurity is built into how KIDAN operates.

  • Be technically involved in assessing KIDAN's cybersecurity architecture, technologies, configurations, controls and implementations.

  • Regularly go beyond governance and documentation to validate that cyber controls are actually implemented and working effectively in practice.

2. Provide Hands-On Technical Cybersecurity Leadership

  • Act as a technical cybersecurity leader who can get into the field and work directly with technical teams.

  • Review and challenge cybersecurity architectures, technical designs, configurations, implementations and controls.

  • Participate directly in complex cyber investigations, incident response, escalations and technical problem-solving when required.

  • Work alongside engineers, cybersecurity specialists and SOC analysts to solve complex cyber challenges and improve technical capabilities.

  • Maintain a strong understanding of the technologies, tools and platforms used across KIDAN's cybersecurity environment.

  • Be able to independently understand and assess technical cyber issues rather than relying exclusively on the team for technical interpretation.

  • Set the technical standard for the cybersecurity organization and continuously raise the team's technical maturity.

  • Remain sufficiently hands-on to maintain technical credibility with both internal teams and enterprise customers.

3. Own & Develop the Cybersecurity Offering

  • Own the strategy, quality and relevance of KIDAN's cybersecurity offering.

  • Continuously challenge and improve our cybersecurity services, capabilities and value proposition.

  • Ensure our SOC and cybersecurity services (e.g. detection and response, threat intelligence, vulnerability management, cyber resilience) are technically strong, operationally mature and aligned with enterprise customer needs.

  • Stay close to the actual delivery of our cybersecurity services and understand how our offerings are implemented in real customer environments.

  • Work with the commercial and technology teams to identify opportunities to grow KIDAN's cybersecurity business and revenue.

  • Ensure what we sell is what we can genuinely deliver at a high standard.

  • Participate in the design and evolution of cybersecurity solutions, architectures and service models.

  • Support the team in complex technical customer opportunities where senior cybersecurity expertise is required.

4. Challenge Cybersecurity Delivery

  • Ensure cybersecurity services and projects are delivered to a consistently high standard.

  • Stay close to delivery and regularly engage with the teams doing the technical work.

  • Challenge processes, technical decisions, architecture and delivery quality where cybersecurity standards are not met.

  • Review technical deliverables and cybersecurity implementations where appropriate.

  • Oversee the SOC team and ensure strong operational performance, processes, quality and continuous improvement.

  • Establish clear cybersecurity KPIs, controls and quality standards.

  • Step into critical delivery, technical escalations or cyber incidents when the situation requires senior technical expertise.

  • Ensure lessons from cyber incidents, projects and customer engagements are translated into improvements across the cybersecurity function.

5. Enterprise Customer & Cybersecurity Escalation Point

  • Act as a senior cybersecurity point of contact for key enterprise customers.

  • Be comfortable going into customer environments and engaging directly with technical teams, cybersecurity teams, IT leaders and executives.

  • Lead or support customer discussions around cybersecurity strategy, architecture, compliance, cyber risk and major requirements.

  • Participate in technical workshops, cyber risk assessments, architecture discussions and complex customer engagements.

  • Act as the escalation point for critical cybersecurity topics, incidents and customer concerns.

  • Be able to discuss technical cybersecurity topics at depth with experienced customer cyber and IT professionals.

  • Build trust with customers by bringing strong technical expertise, credibility and business understanding.

6. Cybersecurity Leadership & Governance

  • Establish clear cybersecurity governance, ownership and decision-making across KIDAN.

  • Ensure cyber risks are visible and appropriately escalated to leadership.

  • Partner with Technology, Compliance, Operations and other functions on cybersecurity priorities and risk management.

  • Lead, coach and develop the cybersecurity team, creating a culture of technical excellence, ownership and continuous improvement.

  • Lead by technical credibility and expertise, not only through management and delegation.

  • Stay current on relevant cyber threats, attacker techniques, technologies, regulations and industry standards, and translate them into actionable priorities for KIDAN.

What Great Looks Like

  • KIDAN has a strong, credible and continuously improving cybersecurity posture. Cybersecurity is not only documented and compliant. It is genuinely strong in practice over all KIDAN.

  • KIDAN is recognized internally and externally as a credible cybersecurity partner, not simply an IT company that also sells cybersecurity. KIDAN is able to confidently demonstrate its cyber maturity to enterprise customers.

  • Our cybersecurity offering is relevant, technically strong, differentiated and commercially valuable.

  • Our SOC and cybersecurity services are delivered consistently, professionally and to a high standard. All are continuously challenged and improved.

  • KIDAN's cybersecurity revenue grows because customers trust our expertise and see clear value in our offering.

  • Enterprise customers know they have a senior, credible cybersecurity expert they can trust and escalate to.

  • Cyber risks, incidents and compliance gaps are identified early and acted upon.

  • Technology and cybersecurity teams work closely together, with cybersecurity embedded into how KIDAN builds and delivers technology

Requirements

description:
Location: hybrid (office & remote)

About what. AG

what. is a Zurich-based digital agency. We build websites, e-commerce and growth marketing for Swiss SMEs — and we’re pushing hard into AI-driven delivery, from our own Support Agent to our what. growth product. We’re a small, senior, remote team that likes to work smart and automate the repetitive parts.

About the role

We're looking for a hands-on Managing Assistant for our Head of Web: someone who can genuinely take work off her plate, not just coordinate it, and who is confident working directly in our web tool stack (WordPress, CMS, web tech).

This is a hands-on, hybrid role: operational and administrative support for the Head of Web, plus running smaller web projects of your own — more doing than overseeing.

You'll independently lead smaller website projects, coordinate designers and developers, communicate directly with clients and ensure projects are delivered on time, within budget and to our quality standards.

At the same time, you'll work closely with our Head of Web, helping coordinate larger projects, prepare client meetings, follow up on deliverables and keep day-to-day operations running smoothly.

We're looking for someone who can think ahead, bring structure to a busy environment and take things off the Head of Web's plate without needing constant direction.

The position starts at around 50% (roughly 20 hours per week), with daily check-ins and the potential to grow as responsibilities increase.


What you'll do

Project Management

  • Independently manage smaller website projects from kick-off through design, development, testing and launch.

  • Act as the main point of contact for clients on your assigned projects.

  • Coordinate designers, developers and other specialists to ensure smooth project delivery.

  • Translate client requirements into clear tasks, priorities and deliverables.

  • Manage project timelines, budgets and scope, identifying potential risks early.

  • Coordinate testing, quality assurance and website launches.

  • Keep clients informed about progress, next steps and upcoming milestones.

Support the Head of Web

  • Support the Head of Web in coordinating larger and more complex website projects.

  • Prepare client meetings, agendas, presentations and project documentation.

  • Track open tasks, decisions and deadlines, proactively following up with clients and internal teams.

  • Help prepare project estimates, proposals and statements of work.

  • Support budget tracking, resource planning and project reporting.

  • Coordinate communication between clients, project teams and internal stakeholders.

  • Take ownership of operational and administrative tasks to free up the Head of Web for strategic priorities and client relationships.

  • Identify opportunities to improve internal processes and make project delivery more efficient.

Client Communication & Coordination

  • Handle day-to-day client requests and coordinate their implementation with the team.

  • Ensure requests are properly documented, prioritised and assigned.

  • Follow up on outstanding client feedback, approvals and deliverables.

  • Maintain clear, friendly and professional communication with clients.

  • Support ongoing client relationships by ensuring reliable delivery and responsiveness.

  • Recognize when issues require escalation and involve the Head of Web at the right time.

Key & Essential Skills

Project Management Experience

  • Some experience running or closely supporting website projects (agency or consultancy a plus); full PM seniority is not required.

  • Ability to independently manage smaller projects while supporting larger, more complex initiatives.

  • Strong organizing skills and the ability to manage multiple projects, deadlines and stakeholders simultaneously.

  • Experience coordinating cross-functional teams, including designers and developers.

  • Good understanding of project budgets, timelines, scope and change requests.

Technical & Digital Understanding

  • Solid understanding of website development processes, from design to launch.

  • Real hands-on experience with WordPress (ideally also Payload or similar): you work in these tools confidently, not just know the interface.

  • Basic understanding of UX, digital marketing, SEO and website analytics.

  • Ability to understand technical discussions and translate them into clear actions.

  • Experience with project management tools such as Linear, Jira, Asana or similar platforms.

  • Comfortable using AI tools to improve productivity, documentation and daily workflows.

Communication & Organisation

  • Fluent professional German and strong English communication skills.

  • Excellent written communication and attention to detail.

  • Ability to communicate confidently and professionally with clients.

  • Strong prioritisation skills and a structured, solution-oriented approach.

  • Comfortable working independently while knowing when to ask questions or escalate issues.

  • Proactive in following up on tasks and ensuring nothing falls through the cracks.

What makes you a fit

  • You take ownership. You don't just coordinate tasks; you make sure things actually get done.

  • You're one step ahead. You anticipate what needs to happen next and take action without waiting to be asked.

  • You bring structure. You enjoy organising information, managing priorities and keeping multiple projects moving.

  • You're a strong communicator. You know how to keep clients informed, manage expectations and communicate professionally.

  • You're detail-oriented. You notice missing information, unclear requirements and potential problems before they become bigger issues.

  • You're a team player. You're equally comfortable leading your own projects and supporting someone else in delivering larger initiatives.

  • You're adaptable. You can switch between project management, client communication and operational tasks without losing track of priorities.

This role is ideal for someone who enjoys the variety of agency work, likes taking responsibility and gets satisfaction from making complex workflows run smoothly.

You'll have the opportunity to manage your own projects while working closely with an experienced Head of Web, gaining exposure to larger enterprise clients and more complex digital initiatives.

Perks

  • Beautiful office in Seefeld, Zurich, for candidates working in a hybrid setting.

  • Flexible working hours and the opportunity to work remotely.

  • Real responsibility and ownership of your own projects.

  • Close collaboration with the Head of Web and exposure to enterprise-level digital projects.

  • A multicultural team that learns together, including daily hands-on work with AI tools.

  • Flat hierarchies and a results-oriented working environment.

  • Fair compensation and profit participation.

  • Personal development opportunities and room to grow within the company.

How to Apply

  • Apply via our website with your CV and a 2–3 minute introduction video in German (e.g. Loom or YouTube).

    Tell us what attracted you to this role, share an example of a website project you've managed and explain how you stay organised when juggling multiple priorities.

    👉Applications without a video or sent through other channels (e.g. email or social media) won't be considered.

Job Details

About Salesforce

Salesforce is the #1 AI CRM, where humans with agents drive customer success together. Here, ambition meets action. Tech meets trust. And innovation isn’t a buzzword — it’s a way of life. The world of work as we know it is changing and we're looking for Trailblazers who are passionate about bettering business and the world through AI, driving innovation, and keeping Salesforce's core values at the heart of it all.

Ready to level-up your career at the company leading workforce transformation in the agentic era? You’re in the right place! Agentforce is the future of AI, and you are the future of Salesforce.

The Experience

Salesforce is hiring a Portfolio Leader to directly manage and grow a team of technical AI specialists deploying Agentforce solutions inside complex customer environments. This is a hands-on leadership role for someone who can drive engineering excellence while operating at the executive level. This is not a traditional people manager, but a mission-critical multiplier on the agentic frontier. You will lead a blended delivery team made up of two specialist functions: Forward Deployed Engineers (Technical Builders - who design, build, and deploy AI Agents directly in customer environments) and Deployment Strategists (Strategic Builders - customer-facing advisors who shape AI strategy, define use cases, and drive adoption). Together, these teams work alongside customers to co-build and deliver agentic AI solutions on a single large enterprise account or across multiple engagements simultaneously. You'll set the engineering standards, unblock complex customer deployments, and scale the talent that's shipping production AI today.

Production leadership required. Builder mindset non-negotiable.

The Builder Leadership Experience

Delivery Team Coordination: You own the capacity planning, talent acquisition, and staffing that ensures your cross-functional squads have the horsepower to deploy Agentforce at enterprise scale.

AI-Augmented Leadership: Your team ships solutions using a best-in-class suite of AI tools (Cursor, Claude, and Salesforce coding products like Vibes). You will foster an inclusive, high-energy, and psychologically safe engineering culture where builders iterate fast and continuously level up.

Direct Product Influence: You stand at the center of the product feedback loop. Partner directly with the Product and Engineering organizations on pilot programs and beta rollouts, turning raw field insights from high-stakes deployments into features on the Agentforce core roadmap.

What You'll Actually Be Doing

Scale Elite Talent: Recruit, mentor, and develop the next wave of Technical and Strategic Builders. Drive technical excellence, structure career growth, and foster an environment where shipping high-quality, production-ready systems is the norm.

Maintain Operational Velocity: Monitor key delivery metrics, coach your teams on optimization, and run hard on complex customer escalations. You ensure your teams move from sketch to deployable in weeks, not months.

Ultimate Technical Authority: Serve as the final technical escalation point for your portfolio. Maintain deep architectural judgment across the Salesforce platform, advanced LLM techniques, data pipelines, and agentic orchestration.

Guide Enterprise Implementations: Unblock complex data readiness, tool integration, and multi-agent orchestration challenges. Step in directly to help your teams assess customer technical readiness, remove deployment barriers, and codify standardized, repeatable delivery methodologies.

Drive Agentic Adoption: Build and anchor strong executive-level relationships within your customer portfolio, ensuring flawless Agentforce activation, rollout, and sustained production value.

Accelerate Portfolio Performance: Operationally run your account portfolio with engineering rigor - monitoring health, delivery velocity, and core consumption metrics to accelerate progress toward customer business outcomes.

Cross-Functional Alignment: Partner lock-step with Services, Account Success, and Product teams to help enterprises activate and consume Agentforce quickly, moving customers from pilot to production at hyper-speed.

You're Our Person If...

Advanced Technical Depth: 15+years of Technical background with recent deep architectural understanding of AI, LLMs, and the Salesforce ecosystem. You have hands-on experience with enterprise software implementation, data modeling, API integration, and AI deployments.

You Have Proven Leadership: 3+ years of direct people management or high-impact technical leadership steering cross-functional engineering or technical teams. You have a track record of hiring, mentoring, and scaling technical talent.

You Own the Agentforce & Data Cloud Blueprint: You possess direct, hands-on experience architecting or deploying Salesforce Data Cloud and the Agentforce platform. You don't just understand the tech stack - you know how to orchestrate it to unblock enterprise scale and drive immediate production value.

You Lead with an Enterprise Customer Focus: Strong background navigating high-touch customer strategies at a Global level, paired with exceptional executive-level communication and influence skills. You can hold your own in a room with customer CTOs and enterprise architects.

You Have a Ship-It Mindset: Exceptional problem-solving instincts, extreme resourcefulness, and a "get-things-done" demeanor. You thrive at the technical helm where code is being actively shipped, not just talking about it.

Even Better If...

Hands-on experience building multi-agent systems, prompt engineering pipelines, or deterministic AI guardrails.

Familiarity with cloud data platforms (Snowflake, Databricks, BigQuery) and enterprise data pipelines.

Relevant Salesforce certifications (Advanced Admin, Service Cloud, Data Cloud, Sales Cloud, or Agentforce Specialist).

Unleash Your Potential

When you join Salesforce, you’ll be limitless in all areas of your life. Our benefits and resources support you to find balance and be your best, and our AI agents accelerate your impact so you can do your best. Together, we’ll bring the power of Agentforce to organizations of all sizes and deliver amazing experiences that customers love. Apply today to not only shape the future — but to redefine what’s possible — for yourself, for AI, and the world.

description:
Are you an experienced Statistical Programming professional with deep knowledge of clinical drug development? Would you like to use your technical expertise to provide strategic programming leadership and help shape the delivery of clinical development programmes? Join us at AstraZeneca CVRM (Cardiovascular Renal Metabolism) Biometrics to impact a wide range of engaging projects striving to make a difference for millions of patients. Our Biometrics team consists of Statisticians, Programmers, Information and Data Scientists. We drive and contribute to optimized clinical drug development programs and access to information and scientific knowledge management.

We are now offering an exciting opportunity for a dedicated and highly motivated individual to join us as Statistical Programming, Associate Director, providing strategic programming leadership within CVRM Biometrics and collaborating with global product development teams.

This role is primarily focused on strategic and technical leadership, planning and project management rather than hands-on statistical programming. You will draw on your technical programming expertise to provide direction, oversee delivery and support high-quality decision-making.

This role will be placed at AstraZeneca’s dynamic R&D strategic site in Gothenburg (Sweden), where you will work in an international environment at the forefront of clinical development.

Accountabilities:

As a Statistical Programming, Associate Director, you are accountable for quality, timely and efficient delivery of project programming work and information management. This position requires profound programming experience and excellent industry knowledge to provide strategic and technical leadership across programming activities, including planning and project management. This is a strategic leadership role with project and technical focus where you will provide subject matter expertise within the statistical programming discipline. You will oversee the delivery of data according to industry standards, and high-quality statistical analyses and reporting deliverables, as well as planning and execution of submission strategies. You will act as a specialist within cross-functional teams to drive continuous improvement, innovation, and automation solutions.

Essential Skills/Experience:

Degree in Mathematics (e.g., Applied Math, Engineering, etc.), Statistics, Computer Science, Life Science, or equivalent experience

Advanced knowledge of the clinical development process and industry standards

Demonstrated programming leadership capability, with the ability to provide strategic and technical direction, develop teams and individuals, and lead them towards a common goal without formal line management responsibility

Demonstrated influencing, planning and organizational skills

Ability to provide input to functional strategies

Expertise in risk management in complex or novel situations

Strong technical experience in SAS and CDISC standards, together with current knowledge and awareness of regulatory requirements relevant to Statistical Programming

 

Desirable Skills/Experience:

Broad experience, ideally across multiple therapeutic areas and/or beyond Statistical Programming

Experience in regulatory submissions and regulatory interactions

Demonstrated experience in designing and implementing business processes

Willingness and ability to travel

At AstraZeneca, we believe in the potential of our people, and you’ll develop beyond what you thought possible. We make the most of your skills and passion by actively supporting you to see what you can achieve no matter where you start with us. In this role, you’ll play a pivotal role in channeling our scientific capabilities to make a positive impact on changing patients’ lives and join us on an exciting journey to pioneer the future of healthcare.

This role is an office-based role with some degree of flexibility. Our vibrant office sites provide a diverse and collaborative work environment, where interactions lead to ideas and innovations, giving you and others the perfect opportunity to learn, grow and develop careers.

Are you ready to bring new ideas and fresh thinking to the table? Brilliant! We have a seat available, and we hope it’s yours. Apply today!

Welcome with your application no later than November 18th, 2026.

title: Director EUIT, Finance Product Impact, Value and Portfolio
description:
The Director, Finance Product Impact, Value and Portfolio is accountable for proving and growing the value delivered by all 17 Finance IT products across Core Finance and Finance Planning and Analytics. This role owns product health and maturity measurement, value-realisation and benefits tracking against the run-cost bridge, the product portfolio and demand pipeline, product craft standards, and the single in-house performance scorecard for AI agents and partner delivery pods. Reporting to the Executive Director, Finance IT, and leading a team of four, the Director gives the leadership team the evidence needed to decide where to invest, sustain, consolidate or retire, and to confirm that the product-and-platform operating model is delivering outcomes, not just activity. Central to the role is making the true value of IT visible and credible to the business; recognising IT not merely as a cost to be contained but as a driver of capacity, speed, quality, control and competitive advantage for the Core Functions and translating that value into hard outcomes, including a measurable productivity saving of at least 10% for each function served. The Director partners closely with the two Product Line Leads, the Senior Director Product Design and Solutions, the Director Transformation and Product Experience, senior Finance business leaders, strategic partners, Procurement, and Central Technology Risk and Data Governance to maximise value and innovation in a product-centric organisation. 

  

Key Responsibilities  

Value Realisation and Benefits Tracking: Define and run the value-measurement discipline across all 17 products, tracking benefits against the run-cost bridge ($20.0M today to the $15.0M plan of record and the $13.5M stretch aim). Report the value of agents that run IT itself and of agents that serve the business separately, never netted. Own the target of delivering a 10% productivity saving for each Core Function releasing time, effort and spend to be reinvested in higher-value work and evidence it product by product alongside the run-cost bridge, so the function sees a clear, auditable return on its IT investment.  

• Product Health and Maturity: Maintain one consistent health and maturity view of every product, covering adoption, quality, user experience, run cost and control health. Trigger intervention with the Product Line Leads where a product falls below threshold, and keep the evidence base current for leadership and gate reviews.  

• Portfolio and Demand Management: Own the portfolio and demand pipeline and keep prioritisation honest. Recommend which products to invest in, sustain, consolidate or retire, and support the phased launch of the 17 products.  

• Agent and Pod Performance Scorecard: Own the single scorecard for AI agents and partner delivery pods, covering accuracy, deflection, Service-Level Agreement and Experience-Level Agreement performance, and cost. Provide the evidence for the agent governance plane and for the two-of-four pause criterion at each phase gate.  

• Product Craft and Standards: Raise product-management craft across Product Owners and Product Analysts through standards, playbooks, coaching and a graduate pipeline, so that every product team operates to a consistent, defensible bar.  

• Team Leadership: Lead and develop a high-performing team of four, comprising two Value Measurement Leads and two Product Craft and Agent Scorecard specialists. Foster a culture of evidence, accountability and continuous improvement, and own talent development and succession planning for key roles.  

• Stakeholder and Partner Management: Manage and influence the Executive Director, Product Line Leads and senior Finance business leaders on value and portfolio decisions. Hold the embedded Outsourcing partner to account on outcome measures, working with EUIT Operational Excellence on supplier governance and with Procurement on commercial terms such as gain-share and service credits.  

• Governance, Risk and Compliance: Ensure value, benefits and scorecard reporting is auditable and evidence-based. Work with Central Technology Risk and Data Governance on AI guardrails, and ensure no agent is treated as a control until the first clean financial year-end and per-agent auditor sign-off are in place. 

• AI Adoption and Change Management: Be the thought leader for measuring the impact of AI digital workers. Feed adoption and performance evidence to the Director Transformation and Product Experience and the Senior Director Product Design and Solutions so that digital-worker leverage is directed where it creates most value. 

• Budget Management: Develop, deliver and monitor the budget, including capital, for the Product Impact, Value and Portfolio area, and track the savings run-rate against plan, flagging early where it falls below 85% of plan.  

Key Qualifications, Skills and Experience  

Key Qualifications:  

• Bachelor’s degree in a relevant field of study – Finance, Business, Engineering, Computer Science or Information Technology. Masters degree desirable.  

• Significant experience in a client-facing IT or product role, including strategic planning, business plan and case development, and client management.  

• Significant experience in value realisation and benefits tracking, including business models, operating models, financial models, cost-benefit analysis, budgeting and risk management.  

• Significant experience in product-centric operating models, including product portfolio and demand management, product health and maturity measurement, and product-management craft.  

• Significant experience working with diverse business ecosystems, Cloud and software-as-a-service models, and business applications. More specifically: SAP S/4HANA, BlackLine, Anaplan, Snowflake, Coupa, Concur and AWS Bedrock plus AI foundation models, large language models and measuring the performance of AI agents.  

• Significant experience in one or more Finance areas with a comprehensive understanding of business processes and drivers for success, such as record to report, purchase to pay, order to cash, and planning and forecasting.  

• Experience working with regulatory and control aspects of IT solutions in Finance, including Sarbanes-Oxley attestation and audit-ready evidence.  

• Experience having led large-scale change initiatives from planning to implementation.  

• Experience managing teams with direct and indirect reports, including work delivered through outsourced managed-service partners.  

• Experience managing outcome-based managed-service contracts, including Service-Level Agreements, Experience-Level Agreements, service credits and gain-share mechanisms.  

• Experience in co-working with cross-functional global leadership and other senior stakeholders preferred.  

• Substantial experience managing in a global matrix organisation with geographically dispersed teams.  

• Substantial experience communicating with and influencing diverse internal and external stakeholders, including supplier and vendor networks, across areas and geographies to drive value and portfolio outcomes.  

• Substantial experience anticipating, assessing and managing programme and portfolio risks.  

• Certification in product management, portfolio management or business analysis preferred.  

  

Skills & Technical Proficiency:  

• Critical/ Strategic Thinking: Influences the broader business strategy with data and insights and anticipates futuristic changes.  

• Results & Execution Focus: Sets ambitious yet realistic value targets, measures them rigorously and holds product teams and partners to outcomes.  

• Business & Sustainability: Leverages a strong understanding of the organisational structure and business financials to make strategic recommendations and advocate for sustainable business strategies.  

• Adaptability & Change Orientation: Champions bold moves and systemic changes and models resilience when faced with unexpected changes.  

• Communication, Collaboration & Influence: Is an inspiring communicator, builds strong partnerships, and bridges silos to achieve broader organisational goals.  

• Talent Development: Champions a culture based on feedforward, coaching, and stretch development and ensures a level playing field for diverse talent.  

• Business & Customer Centricity: Leverages a strong understanding of Finance functional domains, customer processes and the related IT landscape to judge where product investment creates most value.  

• Value & Insight Storytelling: Turns product, cost and performance data into clear, decision-ready evidence for the Executive Director and senior Finance leaders, and is candid when the evidence is unwelcome.  

• Product Craft & Portfolio Judgement: Applies product-management standards and portfolio thinking to prioritise, sequence and retire products, balancing value, risk and capacity.  

• AI Performance Measurement: Designs and runs measures for AI agents and partner delivery pods, and drives a culture of proactive change, skill building and application around emerging technologies and ways of working. 

Next Steps? 

Are you ready to step up and take ownership of your work, solutions for the business and your personal career development? Apply now and join us in our mission to bring life-changing medicines to people!

Scale our operations for global impact. Build the systems and teams – so our radar tech delivers everywhere it counts.

description:
Before jumping into all the information about the role and what you can bring to the table, let us introduce ourselves real quick.

About us

Insider One is the #1 platform that brings everything marketing and customer engagement teams need in one place so they can reach their peak potential and become unstoppable. 

Our story began with six desks and a vision to create a single platform to make industry-first technologies and emerging channels accessible to marketers worldwide. Today, Insider One is powered by 1,500+ team members representing 50+ nationalities across 30+ offices.  With AI at its core and an integrated Customer Data Platform (CDP), Insider One unites data, personalization, and journey orchestration across the most extensive set of natively supported channels, including WhatsApp, SMS, Email, Web, App, and Site Search. 

We recently raised one of the largest funding rounds in the industry, a $500M Series E led by General Atlantic. We are backed by top-notch investors, including Sequoia Capital, QIA, Riverwood, and Endeavor Catalyst, and trusted by 2000+ customers from high-growth startups to the most prestigious Fortune 500 companies such as Samsung, Nike, L’Oreal, Singapore Airlines, Nestlé, Nissan, Lenovo, Puma, IKEA, Allianz, Domino's, and the list goes on.

Insider One was congratulated for becoming one of the only woman-founded, women-led B2B SaaS unicorns in the world. Loved by customers, recognized by analysts, we are the only vendor recognized as the #1 leader in all the capabilities marketing and customer engagement teams need. Don’t just take our word for it — see for yourself. We consistently outperform and continue our leadership, and the results speak for themselves.

From day one, Insider One’s mission has not only been to build a world-class product company, but also to create one of the most socially progressive technology communities in the world. Through our social responsibility initiatives like 100 Social Responsibility Projects, AI Training for Teachers, Code Academy, SheCodes, SheLeads, and SheMarkables, our community has committed to scaling its impact on our communities across 30+ countries, driving initiatives in health, education, farming, animal rights, and increasing women’s representation in STEM.

Behind all these achievements is an exceptionally talented, visionary team of overachievers that moves fast and agile, creating cutting-edge products, and focuses on making an impact. If you want to be a part of this journey, just keep reading.


About the role

We are looking for a Director, Commercial Partnerships to lead Insider One’s technology and solution partner ecosystem across the United Kingdom, Ireland and the Nordics.

You will own the regional partnership strategy and its commercial results: identifying where partners can accelerate growth, building mutually valuable relationships, and turning those relationships into qualified pipeline, revenue and customer success.

Your portfolio will span complementary technology providers and solution partners, including agencies, consultancies and systems integrators. You will bring these partners together with Insider One’s regional sales and customer teams to develop compelling customer propositions and repeatable routes to market.

This is a hands-on leadership role for someone who combines strategic judgment with strong execution. You should be equally comfortable developing an executive relationship, building a joint business plan and working alongside an account executive to advance an opportunity.


What you will do

Own the regional partner strategy

  • Develop and execute a commercial partnership plan aligned with growth priorities across UK&I and the Nordics.

  • Assess the existing ecosystem and recruit partners where there is a clear customer need, complementary capability and mutual commercial opportunity.

  • Concentrate investment on a focused portfolio of partners with the commitment and capacity to deliver measurable results.

  • Establish joint business plans with clear outcomes, accountable owners and regular performance reviews.

    • Build and activate technology partnerships

  • Develop relationships with complementary marketing, commerce, analytics, loyalty and other technology providers.

  • Translate complementary capabilities into customer use cases, joint propositions and commercial opportunities.

  • Build referral and co-selling motions that connect partner teams with Insider One’s regional sellers.

  • Coordinate with global alliance owners to maintain clear ownership and alignment on strategically managed relationships.

    • Develop solution partnerships

  • Recruit and activate agencies, consultancies and systems integrators with relevant customer relationships and delivery expertise.

  • Build a compelling commercial proposition that connects Insider One’s growth with partners’ opportunities to generate services revenue and deepen customer relationships.

  • Work with internal specialists to help partners develop the knowledge and capabilities required to recommend, implement and support Insider One.

  • Connect solution and technology partners around shared customer opportunities, combining platform capabilities with implementation and strategic services.

    • Deliver commercial outcomes

  • Own agreed targets for partner-sourced pipeline and revenue, alongside clearly defined partner contributions to sales and expansion opportunities.

  • Work with account executives on named-account plans, customer introductions, opportunity qualification and joint pursuits.

  • Establish executive and field relationships within priority partners, securing commitment to specific opportunities and growth plans.

  • Partner with Marketing on targeted campaigns and events tied to named audiences, opportunity creation and pipeline progression.

  • Maintain accurate opportunity records, attribution and forecasts in Salesforce, with clear next steps and ownership.

    • Build a repeatable operating model

  • Equip Insider One and partner teams to recognize opportunities, articulate joint value and work together effectively.

  • Establish practical rules of engagement for referrals, co-selling, deal registration and customer handoffs.

  • Evaluate partner performance through pipeline quality, revenue, conversion, customer outcomes and economic value for both organizations.

  • Use evidence to refine the portfolio, expand successful motions and redirect investment where results fall short.


    • What you will bring

  • Significant experience in commercial partnerships, alliances or channel development within enterprise SaaS, with a track record of delivering measurable growth.

  • Experience building and activating both technology and solution partnerships, including agencies, consultancies or systems integrators.

  • Strong knowledge of the UK&I and Nordic markets, with relevant ecosystem relationships and the ability to build new ones.

  • An understanding of marketing technology, customer engagement and commerce, and how software providers and service partners create value together.

  • Evidence of translating partner relationships into qualified opportunities and revenue through referrals, co-selling and joint account planning.

  • Commercial judgment: you can assess partner potential, understand incentives and focus resources where both organizations can succeed.

  • The ability to earn executive trust while engaging directly with sales, marketing and delivery teams.

  • Strong communication, negotiation and analytical skills, including the ability to explain customer value clearly and assess partnership performance.

  • The initiative to build in an evolving environment, establish priorities and follow through on commitments.

  • Willingness to travel across the region for partner and customer engagement.


    • What We Offer
  • Be part of a diverse team that’s as global as it gets — where every voice is heard and 50+ nationalities build together.
  • Level up with internal trainings covering AI fundamentals, coding, foreign languages, and a wide range of personal development skills.
  • Feed your curiosity with access to Spotify, LinkedIn Learning, Blinkist, MasterClass, and CloudGuru.
  • Become a Shareowner through our eligibility-based “ESOP” and own a piece of what you build.
  • Help build the team you want to work with and enjoy rewarding referral bonuses.
  • Opportunities to give back to your community through volunteering and purpose-driven social impact projects.
  • From global retreats to team-building activities, expect year-round events that turn into lifelong memories.
    • We aren't just hiring for a position; we are hiring for a mission — a mission to build a lasting legacy that will set the benchmark for the most progressive tech companies out there. 
     
    To do this, we are looking for exceptional talent to join a community of good-hearted individuals who take high ownership and are relentlessly driven to go the extra mile.
