Description

Prime Air is seeking a Technical Program Manager to drive airworthiness certification programs for the MK30 unmanned aircraft system. You will own the plans, schedules, and compliance tracking that turn certification strategy into execution. This role sits at the intersection of engineering and regulatory compliance. You will coordinate across software, hardware, systems, and test teams to keep certification deliverables on track and surface risks early.

A key dimension of this role is international regulatory coordination. Prime Air operates across multiple countries, each with its own aviation authority and certification expectations. You will manage the programs that drive international approvals of the drone system. You will track regulatory deltas across jurisdictions and maximize reuse of compliance evidence, so each country is not run as a separate program.

You will report to the Senior Manager, Engineering Certification.

Key job responsibilities

Own the plans, schedules, and compliance matrices for Prime Air's certification programs across DO-178C (software), DO-254 (hardware), and DO-160G (environmental qualification).

Track certification objectives against engineering deliverables. Identify gaps and dependencies early, and drive them to closure.

Partner with engineering teams to sequence certification work within the development lifecycle. Escalate schedule and resource risks to leadership.

Build and maintain the status reporting, metrics, and dashboards that give leadership visibility into certification progress

Coordinate the programs that support regulatory engagement across the markets Prime Air operates in (EASA, CASA, DGCA, CAA, JCAB, and others).

Track regulatory requirements and deltas across authorities. Manage the evidence reuse plan that supports bilateral validation processes (for example, FAA-to-EASA) to reduce international approval timelines.

Monitor emerging regulations (for example, EU U-Space, FAA BVLOS rulemaking) and fold new requirements into program plans before they become blockers.

Drive alignment across engineering, regulatory, and certification teams on scope, milestones, and means of compliance.

Support the Senior Manager and certification engineers in preparing compliance arguments and documentation for the FAA, EASA, and international DERs/CVEs.

Establish and improve the program mechanisms that scale certification delivery as Prime Air expands internationally.

About the team

This is a new organization within Prime Air to own the technical execution of certification to support our world-wide expansion focus in 2027 and beyond.

Basic Qualifications

- 5+ years of technical product or program management experience

- 7+ years of working directly with engineering teams experience

- 5+ years of project management disciplines including scope, schedule, budget, quality, along with risk and critical path management experience

- Experience managing projects across cross functional teams, building sustainable processes and coordinating release schedules

- Experience defining KPI's/SLA's used to drive multi-million dollar businesses and reporting to senior leadership

- Experience developing and executing/delivering product and technical roadmaps

- Experience in industry work in a related environment

The Amazon Leo Electronic Supply Chain team is seeking an Operations Technical Program Manager to drive technical manufacturing and supply chain operations for Printed Circuit Board Assemblies (PCBA) destined for our satellites. The successful candidate will manage contract manufacturers' end-to-end production processes and work with internal customers like design and reliability engineering while maintaining a focus on quality and delivery requirements.

Description

Amazon Logistics (AMZL) is on a mission to build the most advanced last-mile delivery network in the world. Our Central Engineering – Robotics & Innovation team is at the forefront of this transformation, developing and deploying automation and robotic systems that power delivery stations across North America and beyond. Our objective is to fully automate our Delivery Stations, achieving zero-touch unit-to-recipient (UTR) operations end-to-end.

We are seeking an experienced, innovative, and customer-obsessed Technical Program Manager to drive the end-to-end lifecycle of robotics and automation programs — from early ideation and concept validation through large-scale field deployment and performance ramp-up. This is a high-impact, high-visibility role that combines strategic program leadership with deep technical engagement across robotics, mechatronics, controls, and software disciplines.

If you thrive in a fast-paced, entrepreneurial environment and want to make a measurable difference in how Amazon delivers to customers — come help us make history.

Key job responsibilities

Own end-to-end program management for robotics and automation initiatives across the AMZL delivery station network - scope, schedule, cost, risk, and performance.

Lead cross-functional teams spanning hardware engineering, software development, controls, operations, RME, process engineering, and external vendors to deliver integrated robotic solutions at scale.

Drive the full technology lifecycle: ideation to concept design to prototyping to pilot validation to GA deployment to continuous performance improvement.

Define pilot criteria, success metrics, and GO/NO-GO frameworks for new automation technologies entering the AMZL network.

Develop and maintain detailed deployment plans, including critical path scheduling, resource planning, and sequencing, validated through simulation and modeling tools.

Author business cases and strategic narratives for introducing new automation to the delivery station network; present to Director- and VP-level audiences.

Capture voice-of-the-customer directly from field operations (Ops, Maintenance, ACES, Process Engineering, Associates) and translate insights into actionable engineering and roadmap improvements.

Partner with BI and Data Engineering teams to establish KPI frameworks and performance visibility dashboards for deployed robotic systems.

Drive continuous improvement across deployment cycle time, system reliability, and operational throughput, identifying bottlenecks and delivering measurable efficiency gains.

Lead technical design reviews; propose and influence solution architectures for robotic cells, autonomous vehicles, material handling, and sortation systems.

Manage contractor and vendor relationships; ensure delivery commitments are met to quality, timeline, and cost targets.

Lead value engineering initiatives to minimize CAPEX while maintaining performance standards.

Travel 25-50% to delivery stations and partner sites across North America for field validation, deployment support, and stakeholder engagement.

A day in the life

Your day could start with a technical design review for a robotic induction system being piloted at in delivery station, shift to a vendor alignment call on a mechatronics integration timeline, and end with drafting a VP-level narrative on program status for a quarterly business review. You are the connective tissue between the engineers building the future of AMZL and the operators running it today - making sure what we invent actually works at Amazon scale, safely and reliably.

It's always Day 1.

About the team

The Robotics and Innovation team within AMZL Central Engineering develops and deploys automation solutions that drive our objective of fully automated, zero-touch unit-to-recipient (UTR) delivery-station operations, eliminating manual risk and unlocking throughput at scale. We are part of the Worldwide (WW) AMZL team, partnering closely with peer Robotics and Innovation organizations across geographies to share technology, standards, and best practices.

We are a set of diverse individuals who work coherently to solve customer problems with the most innovative solutions. We put heavy emphasis on empowering our employees to maintain work life harmony. The team works with innovative technologies in the market to bring into AMZL to solve complex technical problems. It is a fine balance between working on writing strategic business cases to understanding the deep human machine interfaces.

- Experience managing programs across cross functional teams, building processes and coordinating release schedules

- 7+ years of working directly with engineering teams experience

- Bachelor's degree

- 5+ years of technical product or program management experience

- Experience managing complex, cross-functional programs involving robotics, automation, mechatronics, or industrial hardware systems

- Experience owning/driving roadmap strategy and definition end-to-end

- Experience working directly with engineering teams (hardware, software, controls) through the full product development lifecycle

- Experience managing vendors, contractors, and external technology partners

Preferred Qualifications

- 5+ years of project management disciplines including scope, schedule, budget, quality, along with risk and critical path management experience

- Experience managing projects across cross functional teams, building sustainable processes and coordinating release schedules

- Experience defining KPI's/SLA's used to drive multi-million dollar businesses and reporting to senior leadership

- Experience deploying robotics, autonomous vehicles, sortation, or industrial automation in a fulfillment, logistics, or manufacturing environment

- Experience with simulation and modeling tools (e.g., AnyLogic, SIM3D, NavisWorks, or equivalent)

You’ll benefit from a supportive work culture that encourages you to learn, develop, and grow your career as you take on challenges and drive innovative solutions for our customers. We empower our team to push the boundaries of what is possible—while learning every day in a supportive leading global company. Visit our Careers website to learn more. 

At Applied Materials, we care about the health and wellbeing of our employees. We’re committed to providing programs and support that encourage personal and professional growth and care for you at work, at home, or wherever you may go. Learn more about our benefits. 

About the Role

We are seeking a Level 4 Facilities & Real Estate Technical Project Manager to lead delivery of mission-critical infrastructure projects that enable semiconductor R&D and advanced manufacturing operations.

This role is accountable for cleanroom retrofit/build projects and tool-ready infrastructure/process utilities (highest priorities), managing work from feasibility through commissioning and turnover in a live, operational environment.

This is a senior individual contributor role (no direct reports) that operates in a matrix environment with strong support from controls, electrical, IT, gas/life safety, EHS, and administrative resources.

The TPM will own scope, schedule, and CAPEX forecasting, and will lead cross-functional alignment with lab owners, R&D/Engineering, Operations, and Logistics.

Note: This role does not coordinate tool installs directly; it is responsible for delivering infrastructure readiness to support tool installation and ongoing operations.

What You’ll Do (Key Responsibilities)

Project Leadership (End-to-End Delivery)

Lead facilities and real estate capital projects from concept/feasibility through design, construction, commissioning, and closeout.

Develop and manage project execution plans including phasing strategies, shutdown/tie-in plans, and business continuity measures for live operations.

Drive disciplined scope definition and establish clear design and construction deliverables, acceptance criteria, and turnover requirements.

Top Priority #1: Tool-Ready Infrastructure / Process Utilities

Deliver infrastructure upgrades and expansions supporting semiconductor tools and R&D operations, including coordination of HVAC and environmental control systems; process and general exhaust systems; make-up air and airflow balance strategies; clean dry air (CDA), vacuum, and other process utilities (as applicable); electrical distribution; controls/BMS integration; and monitoring systems.

Coordinate specialty gas infrastructure interfaces in partnership with gas/life safety SMEs.

Ensure infrastructure designs and field execution align with operational needs, reliability targets, and safety requirements.

Top Priority #2: Cleanroom Retrofit / Build

Lead cleanroom retrofit/build efforts while protecting contamination control, safety, and uptime.

Coordinate cleanroom design and execution considerations including ISO classification considerations, pressure regimes, airflow patterns, filtration strategies, and contamination control practices during construction.

Plan commissioning readiness and operational turnover.

Construction & Contractor Management

Lead RFP development, bid evaluation, contractor selection recommendations, and ongoing contract administration in partnership with Procurement.

Manage construction execution including RFIs, submittals, field coordination, quality inspections, safety compliance, change management, schedule recovery plans, and punch list closure.

Coordinate commissioning activities, turnover documentation, and closeout packages.

Financial & Schedule Ownership (L4 Expectations)

Own project financial management with emphasis on CAPEX forecasting, monthly projections, accrual coordination, and variance analysis (PO approval monitoring).

Evaluate change orders and manage forecast impacts (cost and schedule).

Build and maintain integrated schedules in Microsoft Project (required) including logic ties, milestones, critical path management, and progress updates.

Partner with controls support for reporting and schedule performance insights; Primavera P6 exposure is a plus for future scaling.

Cross-Functional Stakeholder Leadership (Matrix Execution)

Serve as the primary project integrator across Facilities, EHS, Security, IT, Engineering, R&D, Operations, and Logistics.

Lead effective meetings (weekly project reviews, design reviews, construction coordination, commissioning readiness).

Communicate clearly to technical and non-technical stakeholders; escalate risks early with recommended mitigation paths.

Influence without authority while maintaining accountability across internal partners and contractors.

What Success Looks Like (Performance Outcomes)

Infrastructure readiness delivered on time to support tool enablement and lab operations (tool install managed by others).

Cleanroom retrofit/build projects executed with strong contamination control, safety performance, and minimal operational disruption.

Forecast accuracy improves over the project lifecycle with transparent variance explanations and proactive corrective actions.

Contractors managed effectively: quality execution, controlled change, safe work, and predictable turnover.

Stakeholders describe execution as disciplined, transparent, and operationally sensitive.

Required Qualifications

5–10 years of progressive project management experience in facilities capital projects; 10–15 years preferred for complex, independent ownership.

Demonstrated delivery of MEP-intensive projects in operational environments (manufacturing, life sciences, data centers, advanced R&D, or similar).

Proven ability to lead construction administration including RFIs, submittals, contractor performance management, and change control.

Strong competency in CAPEX forecasting, cost tracking, and variance reporting (PO approval not required).

Microsoft Project proficiency (required): ability to build schedules from scratch and manage critical path and updates.

Strong communication and stakeholder leadership in a matrixed environment.

Highly Desirable Qualifications

Experience delivering tool-ready infrastructure for semiconductor or advanced manufacturing environments.

Experience with cleanrooms (retrofit/build, contamination control practices, operational turnover).

Primavera P6 exposure (nice-to-have) for potential future adoption.

PMP (or equivalent) is a plus.

Familiarity with commissioning approaches for MEP/process utility systems and structured turnover documentation.

Core Competencies (Level 4)

Technical breadth: understands how building systems interact; can challenge assumptions and spot coordination gaps.

Owner-rep rigor: clear scope control, disciplined change management, contract/commercial awareness.

Operational sensitivity: plans work to protect uptime, safety, and contamination control.

Predictive management: anticipates risk and communicates mitigation early; drives decision-making.

Stakeholder leadership: influences without authority, aligns competing priorities, and maintains accountability.

title: Senior TPM, Mathematical Software & Algorithms
description:
Anduril Industries is a defense technology company with a mission to transform U.S. and allied military capabilities with advanced technology. By bringing the expertise, technology, and business model of the 21st century’s most innovative companies to the defense industry, Anduril is changing how military systems are designed, built and sold. Anduril’s family of systems is powered by Lattice OS, an AI-powered operating system that turns thousands of data streams into a realtime, 3D command and control center. As the world enters an era of strategic competition, Anduril is committed to bringing cutting-edge autonomy, AI, computer vision, sensor fusion, and networking technology to the military in months, not years.

 
ABOUT THE JOB
 
The Technical Program Manager, Mathematical Software and Algorithms is responsible for overseeing the development, execution, and delivery of the Battlespace Awareness software for critical programs - ensuring it meets all technical, functional, and business requirements. Battlespace Awareness software services comprise advanced algorithms for sense-making and decision-making at tactical timelines.  This role requires an individual with a strong technical background in software development, particularly in the domain of optimization and estimation, and experience managing complex projects with multiple sub-teams and many stakeholders. The Sr Technical Program Manager will be the linchpin in ensuring that the software is developed in line with the objectives defined and is released according to the planned schedule.
 
WHAT YOU'LL DO
  • Project Leadership and Strategy:
    • Develop and maintain a detailed project and execution plan - including feature development, testing and validation, deployment, and monitoring. 
    • Establish clear objectives and deliverables for the software that align with program needs.
  • Technical Expertise:
    • Maintain a deep understanding of underlying algorithms and software interfaces for battle management, threat prediction, tracking, and classification to ensure that the relevant services integrate effectively with the larger C2 system.
    • Stay updated on the latest techniques to work with subject matter experts in incorporating relevant innovations into the project plan.
  • Documentation and Process Improvement:
    • Ensure comprehensive documentation is maintained for the project, including technical specifications, user manuals, and project reports.
    • Continuously evaluate and improve project management processes to increase efficiency and effectiveness.
  • Release Management:
    • Oversee the planning and execution of the software release process, ensuring that deployment is carried out smoothly and efficiently.
    • Ensure that all software releases meet the defined quality standards before deployment.
  • Stakeholder Communication:
    • Serve as the primary point of contact for all project-related communications, internally across teams and externally with stakeholders.
    • Regularly update stakeholders on project status, risks, and milestones through reports and presentations.
  • Resource Allocation:
    • Assess and allocate necessary resources, including personnel, software, and hardware, to ensure the project is adequately supported.
    • Monitor resource utilization and make adjustments as needed to avoid bottlenecks or resource constraints.
  • Risk Management:
    • Identify potential risks and develop mitigation strategies with the subject matter experts to minimize impact on the project timeline and deliverables.
    • Regularly review and update the risk management plan to reflect changes in the project landscape.
  • Cross-Functional Collaboration:
    • Work with other divisions and departments to ensure software supports the program priorities and meets all integration requirements.
    • Facilitate effective communication and collaboration between the Battlespace Awareness business line and other stakeholders to promote a unified approach to program execution.
REQUIRED QUALIFICATIONS
  • Bachelor's or Master's degree in Computer Science, Engineering, or a related technical field.
  • Extensive project management experience, preferably in software development.
  • Demonstrable understanding of optimization, applied probability, and AI/ML technology.
  • Strong analytical, problem-solving, and decision-making capabilities.
  • Experience with tools like JIRA, Confluence, and GitHub
  • Exceptional verbal and written communication skills.
  • Ability to manage high-pressure situations and tight deadlines.
  • Must be able to obtain and hold a U.S. security clearance.

PREFERRED QAULIFICATIONS:

  • Familiarity and experience working with materiel leadership or mission partners within Army Air & Missile Defense, USMC Ground Based Air Defense, SOCOM, DHS CBP, or allied defense organizations and working knowledge of the counter-UAS and air surveillance competitive landscape.
  • Experience working on or alongside a team developing mathematical software, such as optimization solvers, estimation engines, simulation frameworks, or applied probability models.

Transcripts help us assess your technical and analytical abilities, complementing our interview process in which we also evaluate practical experience and cultural fit. Benefits

At Anduril, we invest in our people. Our comprehensive, competitive benefits package (available at little to no cost to employees) ensures you’re supported in health, recovery, and whatever comes next. For more information, Explore Our Benefits.

 

Protecting Yourself from Recruitment Scams

Anduril is committed to maintaining the integrity of our Talent acquisition process and the security of our candidates. We've observed a rise in sophisticated phishing and fraudulent schemes where individuals impersonate Anduril representatives, luring job seekers with false interviews or job offers. These scammers often attempt to extract payment or sensitive personal information.

To ensure your safety and help you navigate your job search with confidence, please keep the following critical points in mind:

  • No Financial Requests: Anduril will never solicit payment or demand personal financial details (such as banking information, credit card numbers, or social security numbers) at any stage of our hiring process. Our legitimate recruitment is entirely free for candidates.

  • Exercise Caution with Unsolicited Outreach: If you receive any communication that appears suspicious, contains grammatical errors, or makes unusual requests, do not engage. Always confirm the sender's email domain is @anduril.com before providing any personal information or clicking on links.

  • What to Do If You Suspect Fraud: Should you encounter any questionable or fraudulent outreach claiming to be from Anduril, please report it immediately to contact@anduril.com. Your proactive caution is invaluable in protecting your personal information and upholding the security and trustworthiness of our recruitment efforts.

 

Data Privacy

Description

Devices & Services Trust, Privacy and Accessibility (TPA) is responsible for maintaining and raising the trust bar for Amazon customers across 30+ Devices and Services. We offer horizontal services for builders to ensure trust, privacy, and accessibility is built into our products and services. We also build customer-facing capabilities that provide customers with control and transparency while reducing trust risks, and enable partner teams to innovate with appropriate guardrails for privacy, safety and appropriateness, creative content, fairness, veracity, security, and accessibility.

As we expand our scope into trust incident response and crisis management, we are growing the team to address trust risks across our devices and services portfolio. The TPA team is seeking a Technical Program Manager to join our Trust Incident & Crisis Management function. In this role, you will manage incident response for high-severity, trust-impacting events, from intake through containment, mitigation, and closure, operating the mechanisms, playbooks, and metrics that keep this an always-on operation. You will act as incident manager during active events, drive escalations with urgency, keep stakeholders aligned, and write clear briefs for senior leadership. This is a high-impact, high-visibility position that directly protects customer trust across our products and services, and partners with our India-based incident leads to sustain continuous, cross-time-zone (follow-the-sun) coverage.

A successful candidate will have a strong background driving cross-functional programs, solid program-management, technical problem-solving, and communication skills, and be comfortable operating at a technical level with both technical and non-technical stakeholders. You should understand systems and trade-offs well enough to ask the right questions and support sound decisions, derive insights from complex data, write clear business documents, and hold partner teams accountable to shared commitments through to closure. The ability to stay detail-oriented and decisive under pressure will be critical to success in this role.

Key job responsibilities

- Own the end-to-end response for assigned trust-impacting incidents by defining scope and success criteria, proactively identifying and mitigating risks across dependent teams, and driving each case to closure within SLA.

- Set up incident rooms for high-severity events; triage, classify, escalate, and coordinate response under pressure using established severity matrices.

- Partner with engineering and product stakeholders to understand system architecture, data flows, and design trade-offs, ensuring remediation meets scalability, performance, and operational standards.

- Drive root-cause analysis and post-mortems (correction-of-error), track corrective and preventative actions across Engineering and Product through to closure, and prepare incident narratives, escalation briefs, and status updates for leadership.

- Evaluate opportunities to apply generative artificial intelligence tools and process improvements to streamline detection and triage workflows, while mentoring peers and contributing to team hiring efforts.

A day in the life

As a Technical Program Manager on the Trust Incident & Crisis Management team, you will work on high-impact, high-visibility programs that directly protect our customers. You start your day triaging newly reported issues across trust surfaces and picking up open incidents and corrective actions. During an active event you step into the incident-manager role: classify severity, coordinate the response, assign clear ownership for each action, and keep every item moving to closure within SLA. Between events you run post-incident reviews, keep playbooks and dashboards current, and partner with Engineering and Product to embed trust-by-design practices upstream. You collaborate across trust, privacy, accessibility, security, engineering, legal, and product teams to drive these programs from intake to resolution.

About the team

Our Trust Incident & Crisis Management function sits within Devices & Services Trust, Privacy and Accessibility (TPA), building the programs and services at Amazon scale that grow customer trust, create mechanisms to meet evolving regulatory objectives, and ensure our partners can fulfill their trust obligations without disruption. We run a single, consistent, always-on operating model for high-severity, trust-impacting events: detection, coordination, containment, and crisis response. This is a newly expanded area of investment, so it is a great time to join and help shape how we build out this capability. We value collaboration, continuous learning, and operational rigor, and we support new members in an environment that celebrates knowledge sharing and mentorship.

Basic Qualifications

- Bachelor's degree in engineering, computer science or equivalent

- 3+ years of technical product or program management experience

- 2+ years of software development experience

- 3+ years of project management disciplines including scope, schedule, budget, quality, along with risk and critical path management experience

- Experience managing programs across cross functional teams, building processes and coordinating release schedules

- Experience with roadmap strategy and definition

Preferred Qualifications

- 3+ years of working directly with engineering teams experience

- Experience in Incident Management, Threat Management, Corporate Investigations, Law Enforcement, Security Operations, Crisis Management or a related field

- Experience working effectively across cross-functional teams and partnering well with people at all levels within an organization

- Experience in root cause analysis and error correction, identifying changes to procedures and systems to implement long-term fixes and avoid repeating issues

- Experience in written and verbal communication with the ability to present complex technical information in a clear and concise manner to executives and non-technical leaders

Trust and Privacy TPM, Devices & Services Trust, Privacy, and Accessibility

Job ID: 10592049 | Amazon.com Services LLC

Apply now

Description

Devices & Services Trust, Privacy and Accessibility (TPA) is responsible for maintaining and raising the trust bar for Amazon customers across 30+ Devices and Services. We offer horizontal services for builders to ensure trust, privacy, and accessibility is built into our products and services. We also build customer-facing capabilities that provide customers with control and transparency while reducing trust risks, and enable partner teams to innovate with appropriate guardrails for privacy, safety and appropriateness, creative content, fairness, veracity, security, and accessibility.

As we expand our scope into trust incident response and crisis management, we are growing the team to address trust risks across our devices and services portfolio. The TPA team is seeking a Technical Program Manager to join our Trust Incident & Crisis Management function. In this role, you will manage incident response for high-severity, trust-impacting events, from intake through containment, mitigation, and closure, operating the mechanisms, playbooks, and metrics that keep this an always-on operation. You will act as incident manager during active events, drive escalations with urgency, keep stakeholders aligned, and write clear briefs for senior leadership. This is a high-impact, high-visibility position that directly protects customer trust across our products and services, and partners with our India-based incident leads to sustain continuous, cross-time-zone (follow-the-sun) coverage.

A successful candidate will have a strong background driving cross-functional programs, solid program-management, technical problem-solving, and communication skills, and be comfortable operating at a technical level with both technical and non-technical stakeholders. You should understand systems and trade-offs well enough to ask the right questions and support sound decisions, derive insights from complex data, write clear business documents, and hold partner teams accountable to shared commitments through to closure. The ability to stay detail-oriented and decisive under pressure will be critical to success in this role.

Key job responsibilities

- Own the end-to-end response for assigned trust-impacting incidents by defining scope and success criteria, proactively identifying and mitigating risks across dependent teams, and driving each case to closure within SLA.

- Set up incident rooms for high-severity events; triage, classify, escalate, and coordinate response under pressure using established severity matrices.

- Partner with engineering and product stakeholders to understand system architecture, data flows, and design trade-offs, ensuring remediation meets scalability, performance, and operational standards.

- Drive root-cause analysis and post-mortems (correction-of-error), track corrective and preventative actions across Engineering and Product through to closure, and prepare incident narratives, escalation briefs, and status updates for leadership.

- Evaluate opportunities to apply generative artificial intelligence tools and process improvements to streamline detection and triage workflows, while mentoring peers and contributing to team hiring efforts.

A day in the life

As a Technical Program Manager on the Trust Incident & Crisis Management team, you will work on high-impact, high-visibility programs that directly protect our customers. You start your day triaging newly reported issues across trust surfaces and picking up open incidents and corrective actions. During an active event you step into the incident-manager role: classify severity, coordinate the response, assign clear ownership for each action, and keep every item moving to closure within SLA. Between events you run post-incident reviews, keep playbooks and dashboards current, and partner with Engineering and Product to embed trust-by-design practices upstream. You collaborate across trust, privacy, accessibility, security, engineering, legal, and product teams to drive these programs from intake to resolution.

About the team

Our Trust Incident & Crisis Management function sits within Devices & Services Trust, Privacy and Accessibility (TPA), building the programs and services at Amazon scale that grow customer trust, create mechanisms to meet evolving regulatory objectives, and ensure our partners can fulfill their trust obligations without disruption. We run a single, consistent, always-on operating model for high-severity, trust-impacting events: detection, coordination, containment, and crisis response. This is a newly expanded area of investment, so it is a great time to join and help shape how we build out this capability. We value collaboration, continuous learning, and operational rigor, and we support new members in an environment that celebrates knowledge sharing and mentorship.

Basic Qualifications

- Bachelor's degree in engineering, computer science or equivalent

- 3+ years of technical product or program management experience

- 2+ years of software development experience

- 3+ years of project management disciplines including scope, schedule, budget, quality, along with risk and critical path management experience

- Experience managing programs across cross functional teams, building processes and coordinating release schedules

- Experience with roadmap strategy and definition

Preferred Qualifications

- 3+ years of working directly with engineering teams experience

- Experience in Incident Management, Threat Management, Corporate Investigations, Law Enforcement, Security Operations, Crisis Management or a related field

- Experience working effectively across cross-functional teams and partnering well with people at all levels within an organization

- Experience in root cause analysis and error correction, identifying changes to procedures and systems to implement long-term fixes and avoid repeating issues

- Experience in written and verbal communication with the ability to present complex technical information in a clear and concise manner to executives and non-technical leaders

Technical Infrastructure Program Manager , IT Services - CIS

Job ID: 10599979 | Amazon.com Services LLC

Apply now

Description

Are you interested in a challenge that will reward your unique blend of business and technology skills? Are you excited by the opportunity to be central in addressing significant business-impacting processes and products? Do you enjoy the challenge and ownership that comes from delivering large, cross-functional, IT projects? As a Technical Infrastructure Program Manager (TIPM) for IT Services, you will have the opportunity to play a pivotal role in the future of IT Services. As a Technical Infrastructure Program Manager, you will be the glue between stakeholders to ensure our customers receive the right outcomes that drive customer obsessed security. As a Technical Infrastructure Program Manager for the IT Services organization, you will facilitate the transition of critical IT Services used by our customers to an externalized network platform that has no reliance on a traditional private corporate style network. In this role you will be the primary point of contact for the assigned services to align customer technical requirements to the business strategy by working cross functionally. This role requires senior program and project management experience, as customer engagement, stakeholder management and effective communication is critical. This role requires you to have effective written and verbal skills as this program has director and VP level visibility. As a TIPM you will ensure projects in the program are being scoped, planned, delivered and closed in line with the agreed success measures, budget, schedule and quality. This will require you to partner with service owners and operators to determine the right business outcomes. 

Roles and Responsibilities 

- Manage and own complex projects having enterprise wide impact.

- Establish the forward looking strategy and gain support for implementation.

- Conduct pre-project requirement gathering, scoping, project approval, planning, oversee delivery and verification of strategic goals.

- Develop gap analysis, functional specifications, project schedules and milestones.

- Work with stakeholders to identify resources, assemble project teams, and assign responsibilities.

- Assess costs, benefits and risks, plus identify and respond to risks and high-priority issues rapidly and effectively through effective action and appropriate escalation.

- Balance business needs with technical and security requirements.

- Clearly communicate goals, responsibilities, issues and status to customers and senior managers.

- Lead and streamline the transition of IT Services in to production.

- Ensure changes are effectively released ensuring feedback mechanisms are established.

- Build effective relationships with stakeholder and service owners.

- Publish accurate and concise reports on time to maintain visibility and accountability.

Success in this role will require: 

- Excellent project and program management skills.

- Thrive in the face of ambiguity and not be deterred to address and prioritize multiple projects.

- Understand strategic initiatives and drive them to a successful conclusion.

- Build trusting relationships allowing you to own and drive programs.

- Strong attention to detail and excellent analytical, written and presentation skills.

- Experience with detailed project planning, reporting, risk management and measurement.

- Strong multi-tasking and influencing skills.

- Excellent organization, analytical, quantitative, and presentation skills.

- Strong bias for action and "get it done" attitude.

- Flexibility to travel, both domestically and internationally, and work within global time zones.

Key job responsibilities

The key job functions of the Technical Infrastructure Program Manager are:

- Own the identification, scoping, and delivery strategy for the Infrastructure and AV solutions in Amazon offices.

- Own projects and initiatives having regional impact, including project schedules and milestones.

- Effectively manage stakeholders to successfully deliver the agreed scope.

- Understand and identify technical obstacles to successfully deliver the designed architecture, identify and mitigate risks.

- Assess costs and benefits and maintain financial reporting control.

- Manage escalation, anticipate and make tradeoffs and balance business needs with technical constraints.

- Clearly communicate project and program status, responsibilities and issues to stakeholders.

A day in the life

Reviewing requests from customers, ensuring that required information is available to understand the ask. Working on new designs, collaborating with customers and stakeholder teams, while being an strong advocate of standards, designing Infrastructure and AV installations. Removing blockers, and handling customer concerns and escalations. Timely updating of project work through the tracking tool, ensuring that updates are concise, but informative for senior management and customers. Working on cross collaboration projects that need Infrastructure and AV expertise and guidance.

About the team

The Corporate Infrastructure Services team (CIS) is part of the IT Services organization that supports all Amazonians at corporate offices. CIS designs, plan, builds, maintains and deprecates the infrastructure in all corporate offices worldwide. This includes running Amazon’s corporate campus & building infrastructure worldwide. We are passionate about ensuring our customers receive world class IT Services and making sure they have the best possible experience while working from the office.

Basic Qualifications

- 3+ years of technical infrastructure management experience

- Knowledge of best practices and emerging technologies, related to infrastructure (i.e. network, data center, hardware, software)

- Experience with varying scenarios of infrastructure builds

- 2+ years of delivering cross functional projects experience

Preferred Qualifications

- 5+ years of project/program management experience

- 3+ years of working directly within engineering teams experience

- Experience leading the design, automation, deployment, and support of large-scale infrastructure

- Experience in project management including resource planning, managing schedules, reporting project status and prioritizing own tasks and those of other team members for multiple projects

- Experience working under pressure in a cross-functional organization

- Experience with information security, relational databases and cloud computing.

description:
Job Description

The core responsibility of this role is a hands-on project delivery partner and PMO lead for emerging technology, AI, and automation in support of major change initiatives/projects in GCTO. The role will also help coordinate PMO tracking and reporting, and work to ensure technology best practices are being applied across initiatives. They will apply data stewardship and data governance principles in the management of applications. The incumbent may also identify, evaluate, build, pilot, and scale digital, AI, and automation solutions that support GCTO.  

Primary responsibilities for the role include: 

Key Responsibilities: 

PMO project coordination 

Contribute to the ongoing management of strategic process improvement initiatives within GCTO. 

Provide general and project support to project managers by promoting cross-initiative alignment and best practice sharing.

AI/Automation strategy & intake 

Partner across HQ Ops and GCTO functions to surface priority pain points and high-value opportunities for automation, analytics, and AI. 

Lead development of business cases including problem definition, options analysis, solution scope, resource/cost estimates, benefits/KPIs, risks, and compliance considerations.

Align local opportunities with GCTO priorities; verify with relevant GCDI/central repositories and teams if there are for similar tools to avoid duplication; summarize reuse opportunities and recommendations as appropriate.

Solution design & delivery

Lead and drive the end-to-end delivery of tools and solutions (e.g., dashboards, workflow automation, AI-assisted processes) using appropriate platforms and methods.

Responsible for escalation to centralized assessment when project requirements exceed local capability or scale.

Translate business requirements into functional/technical specifications and oversee build, testing, validation, and controlled deployment; ensure security, privacy, and quality.

Project reporting, tracking & analytics

Develop or oversee development of project analytics and visualization (e.g., GCTO Project Catalog, GCTO Change Management Dashboard, GCTO Pilot Tracker, etc) to track deadlines, deliverables, resources and timelines.

Define and track project success metrics (e.g., cycle-time reduction, accuracy, adoption/satisfaction, cost avoidance/FTE savings) and embed learning loops for continuous improvement.

Governance, compliance & change

Ensure solutions comply with ICH GCP, Company policies, and local regulations; partner with Compliance/Legal as needed.

Maintain project tracking and provide periodic updates via relevant governance forums; support RRO governance processes.

Lead change management efforts, including training plans, communications, and stakeholder engagement; contribute to capability uplift in data literacy and digital ways of working.

Collaboration & solution scaling

Serve as a PMO liaison with functional representatives, Automation/Analytics/AI partners, and when required, IT and external vendors for integration and support.

Share learnings and reusable assets with other functions and project teams; assess and adapt project-specific tools for local use.

Educational Requirements: 

Bachelor’s degree in a life science discipline, business analytics, computing science, engineering, or related field. 

 

Required Experience: 

Minimum of 5 years of relevant experience in data/analytics, process improvement, or technology-enabled transformation within life sciences/healthcare or a comparable regulated environment which includes: 

Successfully designing and delivering automation/analytics/AI-enabled solutions (e.g., dashboards, RPA/workflow automation, AI/ML pilots) that produced measurable improvements. 

Experience coordinating cross-functional stakeholders, with hands-on project management in a matrix environment. 

 

Preferred Experience: 

Experience working across multiple functions or on cross-functional process improvement initiatives. 

Exposure to integrations with IT/data science teams. 

Familiarity with clinical trial processes and operational metrics. 

Compliance/regulatory: understanding of ICH GCP and applicable quality and data protection requirements. 

 

Required Knowledge, Skills and Abilities: 

Business process modeling and requirements techniques: e.g., process mapping, user stories, acceptance criteria, functional specifications 

End-to-end product and solution ownership mindset: with accountability for value delivery across the full solution lifecycle (ideation, MVP, rollout, scaling, maintenance, and retirement). 

Data literacy and analytics: ability to translate business questions into metrics; hands-on with BI tools (e.g., Power BI/Tableau) and data querying basics (SQL or equivalent). 

Automation/AI awareness: practical experience with workflow automation/RPA platforms; exposure to AI/ML use cases and constraints in clinical operations. 

Program/project management: planning, prioritization, risk/issue management, and delivery at pace; comfortable with Agile/Lean practices. 

Communication & influence; ability to influence across functions and present technical topics to non-technical audiences. 

Change enablement: stakeholder engagement, training, and adoption support. 

Problem-solving & critical thinking: structured analysis, hypothesis-driven approach, and pragmatic delivery mindset. 

Required Skills: 
Adaptability, Automation, Cross-Functional Teamwork, Data Analytics, Process Improvements, Project Management, Risk Management, Solutions Delivery, Stakeholder Communications, Workflow Automation

Sr. Technical Infrastructure Program Manager, US West

Job ID: 10603693 | Amazon.com Services LLC

Description

AWS Infrastructure Services owns the design, planning, delivery, and operation of all AWS global infrastructure. In other words, we’re the people who keep the cloud running. We support all AWS data centers and all of the servers, storage, networking, power, and cooling equipment that ensure our customers have continual access to the innovation they rely on. We work on the most challenging problems, with thousands of variables impacting the supply chain — and we’re looking for talented people who want to help.

You’ll join a diverse team of software, hardware, and network engineers, supply chain specialists, security experts, operations managers, and other vital roles. You’ll collaborate with people across AWS to help us deliver the highest standards for safety and security while providing seemingly infinite capacity at the lowest possible cost for our customers. And you’ll experience an inclusive culture that welcomes bold ideas and empowers you to own them to completion.

We’re seeking an experienced Infrastructure Technical Program Manager in Seattle, WA to oversee data center build projects in the US West region. You will lead cross-functional and technical teams from conceptual design feasibility through requirements, budget, completed design, implementation, testing, and deployment. description:
About Mitre Media

Mitre Media is redefining FinTech with AI-driven tools that empower millions of investors. Our portfolio, including Dividend.com and MutualFunds.com, leverages LLMs to deliver novel data insights and visually rich user experiences. For over a decade, we’ve served individual investors, financial advisors, and top asset managers like BlackRock and Vanguard through our premium data, tools, and advertising solutions. Join our lean, entrepreneurial team to shape the future of AI-powered investing from your location ±3 hours from Eastern Time.

Our users are deeply engaged, spending over 5 minutes per visit with a bounce rate below 10%, researching investments across hundreds of different categories. With 40 million brokerage accounts in the U.S., we take pride in building tools that make a real impact, fostering a culture of trust, innovation, and dynamism. If you’re passionate about financial technology and AI, we’d love to connect!

About the Role

As a Full-Stack Rails Tech Lead, you’ll architect and implement LLM-powered web applications within our microservices-based Rails 8 platform. Reporting directly to our CTO, you’ll collaborate with a small, high-impact team to deliver user experiences across Dividend.com, MutualFunds.com and other brands within our portfolio. This role combines expert Ruby on Rails skills with AI integration expertise, requiring you to leverage LLMs in your development workflow, state management and user interactions.

You’ll work in a remote-first hybrid environment, which encourages in person collaboration, using ShapeUp to manage projects that trade-off on-time delivery for de-scoped outcomes. As a technical leader, you'll have a seat at the table shaping system architecture, implementing core features all while embracing an entrepreneurial mindset and a “get things done” mentality.

Responsibilities

  • Architect and maintain Rails applications (Rails 8)

  • Integrate LLMs into our microservices architecture for state management and real-time user experiences.

  • Enhance front-end experiences with Hotwire, StimulusJS, or React, ensuring seamless AI-driven interactions.

  • Optimize LLM inference for low latency and cost, using caching and asynchronous processing.

Required Technical Skills

Back-End

  • Ruby (5+ years, expert-level)

  • Ruby on Rails (Rails 6-8 preferred)

  • PostgreSQL (or MySQL)

  • Elasticsearch

  • Redis

  • Docker

Front-End

  • StimulusJS or JavaScript ES6

  • Tailwind CSS

  • HTML

  • HTTP

AI Integration

  • Experience integrating AI/ML models (e.g., LLMs, NLP) with web applications

  • Familiarity with LLM frameworks (e.g., LangChain, Hugging Face) or APIs (e.g., xAI, Anthropic)

Nice-to-Have Technical Skills

  • Kubernetes for microservices orchestration

  • React for advanced front-end components

  • Graph databases for complex financial data

  • Contributions to open-source RoR or AI projects

Required Soft Skills

  • Entrepreneurial mindset with a passion for AI and FinTech

  • Natural leader who mentors and inspires teammates

  • Problem-solver with a “get things done” mentality

  • Excellent communication, thriving in remote and cross-team collaboration

  • Attention to detail, ensuring clean, maintainable code

  • Team player comfortable as an individual contributor

Why Join Us?

  • Impactful Work: Build AI-powered tools that help millions of investors make informed decisions from data-driven insights.

  • Cutting-Edge Tech: Work with Rails 8, LLMs, and modern tools like Hotwire, Databricks, and xAI’s API in a microservices architecture.

  • Autonomy and Influence: Collaborate directly with our CEO and CTO to shape our AI-driven platform, with freedom to innovate.

  • Competitive Compensation: $160,000–$200,000 CAD/USD (based on experience) and benefits.

  • Remote Flexibility: Remote-first (±3 hours from ET) with hybrid in office collaboration in Toronto or NYC

  • Growth Opportunities: Budget for AI and Rails conferences (e.g., NeurIPS, RailsConf), plus access to cutting-edge AI tools for experimentation.

  • Dynamic Culture: Join a small, no-ego team passionate about trust, innovation, and making a difference in FinTech.

About Mitre Media’s AI-Driven Platform

Mitre Media powers premium financial brands like Dividend.com and MutualFunds.com with the Mitre Platform. This platform integrates traditional content management, financial data, first-party data, ad revenue, and subscription tools, all enhanced by LLMs for rich, user-focused experiences. Our data-derived insights delight users, while our advertising solutions deliver unmatched performance for partners like BlackRock and Vanguard, leveraging advanced targeting and first-party data.

How to Apply

 

Submit your resume, GitHub profile, and a brief note on why you’re excited about building AI-driven FinTech to jobs@mitremedia.com.

The Amazon Corporate Network Engineering team is seeking a Technical Infrastructure Program Manager.

You will define the strategic framework for how designs move from ambiguous business requirements establishing the systems, mechanisms, and governance structures that ensure precision, accountability, and transparency at scale. You will own the end-to-end value proposition of delivery execution: developing comprehensive program plans, defining KPIs that measure success, conducting regular risk assessments across the program lifecycle, and building robust reporting mechanisms that translate complex technical schedules into clear executive narratives for senior leadership.

You will establish program constraints, challenge assumptions as new data arises, and evaluate the feasibility and impact of proposed technical solutions not as the engineer designing the solution, but as the leader who ensures informed decisions drive on-time outcomes. GitHub helps companies and organizations succeed by enabling them to build better software, together. We're looking for a Senior Service Delivery Engineer to support our Expert Services team in solving our customers' needs. The ideal candidate will have the aptitude and passion to become a master of GitHub's product capabilities and underlying technologies. We need a high performing engineering consultant to help our customers improve their software delivery. This person will solve challenges with many different technologies and work closely with our customers, as well as GitHub's internal departments


Responsibilities

Delivery Readiness

At Applied Materials, we care about the health and wellbeing of our employees. We’re committed to providing programs and support that encourage personal and professional growth and care for you at work, at home, or wherever you may go. Learn more about our benefits. 

Key Responsibilities

Support specific project and program objectives as  defined in the areas of responsibility, and that necessary preliminary activities (e.g., determination of outcomes, milestones, viability studies, and resource planning, among others) are completed.

Support projects and programs assigned are completed in accordance with predetermined requirements, with specific attention to product/process specifications, project/program costs, resource utilization, and timeliness for completion.

Ensures that all phases of project, program and/or process development are documented and that information required in other functional areas is reported, disseminated, or transferred, as appropriate. Ensures compliance with Company policies regarding Engineering/Lab notebooks, patents, confidentiality and safety.

Undertake study of new technologies, as appropriate. 

Support data collection for materials & financial resources.

Other Requirements: This position may require standing for extended periods of time, walking, working in tight spaces, bending, squatting, twisting, kneeling, reaching, lifting, the ability to distinguish between colors, the ability to work in an environment with noise that may be difficult for some individuals with sensitivity to noise, and the use of hand and power tools.

Additionally, because this position also may involve working in a clean room, the use of appropriate Personal Protective Equipment such as coveralls, hoods, booties, safety glasses, gloves, respirators, chemical aprons, and face shields may be required.

Functional Knowledge

Demonstrates expanded conceptual knowledge in own discipline and broadens capabilities

Business Expertise

Understands key business drivers; uses this understanding to accomplish own work

Leadership

No supervisory responsibilities but provides informal guidance to new team members

Problem Solving

Solves problems in straightforward situations; analyzes possible solutions using technical experience and judgment and precedents 

Impact

Impacts quality of own work and the work of others on the team; works within guidelines and policies

Interpersonal Skills

Explains complex information to others in straightforward situations

The NSO Project Manager is responsible for the successful execution of assigned Non-System Orders (NSOs) from project release through shipment. This individual contributor role serves as the primary coordinator for complex, customer-specific system configurations, ensuring all project milestones, deliverables, manufacturing requirements, and shipment commitments are achieved.

The NSO Project Manager partners closely with the Business Management Operations (BMO) team, Manufacturing, Engineering, Supply Chain, Planning, Quality, and Configuration Management organizations to manage project execution, mitigate risk, resolve issues, and ensure alignment between customer requirements and factory readiness. The role requires strong project management skills, exceptional organizational abilities, and the capacity to influence cross-functional teams without direct authority.

Key Responsibilities

Own end-to-end execution of assigned NSO projects from order release through shipment.

Translate customer-specific requirements received through the BMO organization into executable manufacturing and project plans.

Develop, maintain, and communicate project schedules, key milestones, deliverables, dependencies, and execution risks.

Coordinate cross-functional teams to ensure engineering, manufacturing, material, quality, and configuration requirements are completed on schedule.

Serve as the central point of coordination for project scope, schedule, configuration, and readiness activities.

Drive execution of customer-specific configurations, engineering changes, BOM modifications, NSRs, CES requests, and other non-standard requirements.

Assess and communicate the impact of project changes on delivery schedules, manufacturing readiness, and shipment commitments.

Facilitate project reviews, readiness reviews, production status meetings, and issue resolution activities.

Monitor project health and performance, identifying constraints and initiating recovery plans when commitments are at risk.

Partner with Master Scheduling, Operations Management, and BMO teams to prioritize deliverables and maintain execution alignment.

Lead risk identification and mitigation activities, ensuring project risks are proactively managed and escalated when necessary.

Coordinate resolution of manufacturing, quality, material, and engineering issues affecting project execution.

Support shipment readiness activities, including final test coordination, documentation reviews, and production release requirements.

Maintain accurate project documentation, action-item tracking, schedule status, and project metrics.

Provide timely status updates, risk assessments, and recovery plans to stakeholders and leadership.

Identify and implement process improvements that enhance NSO execution efficiency, predictability, and customer delivery performance.

Success in This Role Requires

Strong project management, organizational, and prioritization skills.

Ability to manage multiple highly customized projects simultaneously in a fast-paced manufacturing environment.

Knowledge of manufacturing operations, change management, configuration management, and production planning processes.

Strong analytical and problem-solving capabilities with the ability to make data-driven decisions.

Excellent written and verbal communication skills.

Ability to influence stakeholders and drive accountability across multiple functional organizations.

Proven ability to manage risk, resolve conflicts, and maintain commitments in highly dynamic project environments.

Yes, 10% of the Time

No

Strategy & Prioritization

Partner closely with the stakeholders and UX design team to shape and translate product vision into executable roadmaps for the TMS and FO product lines.

Conduct market research and competitive analysis across the F&B tech landscape (reservation platforms, POS ecosystems, food ordering, channel managers) to provide product recommendations.

Evaluate product and integration opportunities by balancing merchant value, patron experience, partner impact, engineering effort, and operational complexity.

Continuously monitor product and partner metrics (e.g. partner-driven bookings, seated conversion, no-show rate) and provide insights to refine priorities and roadmap execution.

Program Management

Lead cross-functional programs from planning through execution across the TMS and FO product surfaces, including different interfaces for both restaurants and patrons, and premium add-on features.

Coordinate closely with Engineering, Design, QA, CSM/BD, Marketing, Operations, and other stakeholders to align priorities and execution.

Manage Product Backlog, Release Planning, Sprint Planning, and Scrum execution.

Identify project risks, resolve blockers proactively, and drive teams toward successful delivery, including launch readiness such as internal playbooks and training.

Global Partner Integration

Own the end-to-end partner integration lifecycle: scoping and scenario design, API documentation and testing setup, kickoff, development support, E2E testing, launch, and post-launch operations.

Manage integrations across partner types — booking platforms, POS systems, membership systems, malls and hospitality groups, and regional restaurant groups.

Serve as the primary technical counterpart for global partners across regions and time zones, running kickoff meetings, joint testing, and ongoing technical communication.

Define integration scenarios, acceptance criteria, and success metrics; keep integration projects transparent and on track for internal and external stakeholders.

Stakeholder Management & F&B Insights

Manage intensive, ongoing communication across internal stakeholders (leadership, Engineering, Design, QA, Go to Market teams with daily interaction, Marketing) and external stakeholders (partners and key merchant accounts) with often-competing priorities.

Develop a deep understanding of restaurant front-of-house operations: reservations as inventory management and capacity planning, reservations as a key patron touchpoint, table management, queuing, no-show and revenue assurance/deposit policies, and online food ordering workflows — and represent the merchant's voices in product decisions.

Translate merchant and partner feedback into clear pain point statements and roadmap inputs.

Support multinational delivery with customers in seven highly differentiated markets, including localization and market-specific requirements across regions such as TW, HK, JP, SEA, and ANZ.

 

Requirements

Required

Experience building B2B or B2B2C SaaS software ; vertical SaaS for F&B, restaurants, or hospitality is a strong plus.

Deep F&B industry knowledge, especially restaurant front-of-house operations: reservation and table management, queuing, deposits/no-show handling, POS, or food ordering.

Strong analytical skills with the ability to translate data into actionable insights.

Excellent cross-functional communication and program management skills; able to work in English with global partners.

Online payment systems, including payment gateways (e.g. Stripe, TapPay), digital wallets (Apple Pay, AliPay, WeChat Pay), deposits/prepayment flows, or subscription billing.

The Role 
 

As a Senior Managing Consultant, reporting to the Head of Consultancy, you will serve as a trusted advisor to senior technology leaders at FTSE and public sector organisations. title: Material Flow Engineer
description:
About Us

Harmattan AI is a next-generation defense prime building autonomous and scalable defense systems. Following the close of a $200M Series B, valuing the company at $1.4 billion, we are expanding our teams and capabilities to deliver mission-critical systems to allied forces.

Our work is guided by clear values: building technologies with real-world impact, pursuing excellence in everything we do, setting ambitious goals, and taking on the hardest technical challenges. We operate in a demanding environment where rigor, ownership, and execution are expected.

About the Role

The Material Flow Engineer designs, builds, and optimizes the end-to-end physical movement and presentation of hardware from receiving docks through warehousing, kitting, and lineside delivery, to support high-rate production schedules and rapid manufacturing scale. This role owns the physical-to-digital operating mechanisms that translate factory layouts and inventory data into executable material handling workflows, including Plan for Every Part (PFEP) management, facility layout engineering, and custom material handling hardware design.

You will serve as the connective tissue between Supply Chain, Manufacturing Engineering, and Production, driving inventory accuracy, eliminating lineside bottlenecks, and deploying low-CAPEX, high-impact floor solutions before scaling to automation. In addition to daily floor execution, you will partner closely with Design Engineering, Program Management, Quality, and Facilities to support New Product Introduction (NPI) line readiness, factory expansions, and continuous lean process improvements.

Key Responsibilities

  • End-to-End Material Flow Design: Analyze, design, and optimize the receiving, storage, movement, and lineside presentation of all production and non-production materials to eliminate technician search and walk time.

  • Plan for Every Part (PFEP) & Data Ownership: Build, maintain, and own the PFEP database defining part dimensions, packaging specifications, containerization, storage media, replenishment triggers (Kanban/min-max), and delivery frequencies.

  • Factory & Warehouse Layout Engineering: Create conceptual and detailed 2D/3D facility layouts (AutoCAD/CAD) for warehouse racking, supermarket zones, tugger routes, and lineside staging to support scalable production rates.

  • Custom Hardware & Packaging Development: Design, procure, and deploy custom material handling equipment, including kitting carts, lineside racks, dunnage, and returnable packaging, to protect sensitive components and ensure seamless point-of-use presentation.

  • Constraint & Bottleneck Mitigation: Conduct daily Gemba walks, time studies, and root-cause analyses to proactively identify material flow bottlenecks, implement poka-yoke (error-proofing) workflows, and resolve floor constraints before they impact build schedules.

  • Cross-Functional & NPI Alignment: Represent material flow readiness in production, NPI, and operational review meetings. Collaborate with Manufacturing Engineering, Quality, and Operations Leadership to support new line launches, facility expansions, and engineering changes.

  • Performance & Data-Driven Optimization: Extract and analyze production, inventory, and cycle-time data using SQL and ERP/WMS systems to right-size buffer stock, monitor key performance indicators (KPIs), and drive down material handling costs.

Qualifications & Skills

  • Masters’s degree in Industrial Engineering, Mechanical Engineering, Manufacturing Engineering, Supply Chain, or a related technical/analytical discipline.

  • 2+ years of hands-on engineering experience in a fast-paced manufacturing, aerospace, defense, automotive, or high-volume production environment involving complex mechanical and/or electrical assemblies.

  • Strong hands-on knowledge of Lean Manufacturing, Just-In-Time (JIT), Kanban, Plan for Every Part (PFEP), and Six Sigma principles applied on an active production floor.

  • Proficiency in 2D/3D CAD software (AutoCAD, SolidWorks, or equivalent) for facility layout engineering and custom cart/rack design.

  • Experience querying and analyzing operational and ERP/WMS data using SQL, Python, or advanced Excel to drive material flow and inventory decisions.

  • Demonstrated experience supporting New Product Introduction (NPI) line launches, greenfield facility buildouts, and production ramps.

  • Strong cross-functional communication skills with a proven ability to influence production teams, engineering peers, and leadership on the shop floor.

  • Adaptable, hands-on problem solver willing to balance analytical modeling with immediate physical execution on the factory floor in a rapidly changing environment.

  • Ability to work 100% onsite and travel up to 20% as needed to supplier sites or sister manufacturing facilities.

We look forward to hearing how you can help shape the future of autonomous defense systems at Harmattan AI.

title: Lab Automation Lead
description:
About us, and our mission

At Orakl Oncology, we are accelerating the development of oncology treatments. Today, fewer than 5% of new cancer drugs succeed in clinical trials. Clearly, new methods are needed. We combine cutting-edge biology and AI to build the next generation of insight platforms with a large cohort of patient-derived tumor avatars. These avatars fuel our predictive engine, helping to anticipate clinical outcomes, validate therapies and uncover new drug candidates. By generating multimodal, real-world data, we aim to make drug development smarter, faster and more personalized. We collaborate with leading hospitals, research institutes and pharmaceutical companies. Backed by leading investors, Orakl is a fast-growing, mission-driven startup at the intersection of biology, automation and AI.

Position overview

Orakl runs a high-throughput 3D cell‑culture platform to culture patient-derived organoids (PDOs). These patient-derived specimens reveal critical information into the patient disease, but require heavy maintenance work. Automating these workflows will be critical to improve the reliability and traceability of experimental work. We are hiring our first automation lead to build the Automation function from scratch. This is a high ownership and high autonomy job. You will map our processes, decide what to automate and what to leave alone, specify and source the equipment, negotiate with vendors and integrators, commission the machines, run them with the lab team, and hire the people the function needs. As the ideal candidate, you have already put automated lines or special machines into service, and you know what typically breaks between commissioning and the first experimental runs. While previous experience in biology is a plus, it is not a strict requirement: you will be taught all you need to know. However, you do need a proven experience in working deeply embedded in interdisciplinary teams.

Key responsibilities

  • Map cell culture workflows end to end and identify key process automation and optimisation opportunities.

  • Own the automation roadmap. Present and lead the implementation of the major decisions to Orakl’s leadership.

  • In line with the automation strategy you will have identified, evaluate vendors and integrators. Write user requirement specifications, acceptance criteria and interface requirements for each project.

  • Negotiate price, scope, delivery, acceptance, support and consumables terms autonomously within agreed thresholds.

  • Lead design reviews and factory and site acceptance tests.

  • Translate our proprietary cell culture protocols into automated machine execution with our team of cell biologists and scientists.

  • Track machine availability, hands-on time per line, interventions, failures and recovery time. Use the data to decide the next step.

  • Coordinate with Orakl’s management to anticipate future automation needs on the platform and adjust the roadmap accordingly.

  • Hire and develop the automation technicians and engineers the roadmap needs.

  • Set the standards for the automated platform: documentation, quality control, safety, qualification, change control, vendor management.

In this role you will collaborate closely with our cell culture, cell biology and data science teams. You will be at the heart of Orakl Oncology’s capabilities roadmap and help generate unprecedented amounts of biological data to power scientific discovery in cancer.

Key qualifications

Must-have

  • Engineering degree (generalist, robotics, industrial, mechanical or process engineering) or equivalent, and at least eight years of experience.

  • Exceptional process thinking skills: you map flows, time operations, find bottlenecks and question the processes.

  • Experience in supplier negotiation and budget ownership on your own projects.

  • Experience in PLC and robot programming concepts, scheduling software, instrument interfaces, basic scripting.

  • You enjoy and are comfortable spending time on the floor with operators. You have experience in communicating and operating with engineers, technicians and workers at the heart of production processes.

  • Autonomy: you tell your manager what you decided and why, not what you need decided.

  • Fluency in English is required.

Nice-to-have

  • You have put automated lines, cells or special machines into service end to end: requirements, vendor selection, negotiation, integration, factory and site acceptance, ramp-up, budget. This doesn’t have to be in a lab environment : plant, food and fermentation, pharma or cosmetics are other examples of relevant experience.

  • Automation in life-science or regulated environments: cell culture, biotech, food and fermentation, pharma, cleanroom or BSL-2 work.

  • A working understanding of cell culture and what it demands: sterility, contamination risk, variability between samples, and steps governed by the biological pace.

  • Liquid handling, plate-based workflows, incubators and imagers; laboratory scheduling software.

  • Experience hiring and leading an automation team.

What we offer

  • You will be Orakl's first automation hire. You will have a unique degree of ownership and scope with a strong mandate to deliver.

  • Short decision lines and fast execution.

  • An interdisciplinary environment with a results-driven culture.

Recruitment process

  1. Introductory call with Talent / People — 20 minutes

  2. Interview with the Lab Director, hiring manager — 45 minutes, including a 15-minute live mini-case on a small lab process

  3. Technical deep dive with the CTO and the Lab Director

  4. Case study on a real part of our lab: a take-home capped at four hours, then a half day on site with presentation, challenge round, lab walk.

  5. Cross-functional interviews with the technicians who run the culture, Platform Operations, the Senior Laboratory Engineers and the Data team — 60 minutes

  6. Reference calls: a former manager, a vendor or integrator you negotiated with, and an operator who ran a line you delivered

  7. Founder conversation — 45 minutes
